4469class DFA:
4470    """Represent a deterministic finite automaton (DFA).
4471
4472    A DFA processes an input string one character at a time using
4473    a transition table. After processing the entire input, the
4474    automaton accepts if its final state is an accepting state.
4475
4476    The DFA operates over a caller-supplied alphabet. Characters
4477    outside that alphabet cause matching to fail.
4478    """
4479
4480    def __init__(
4481        self,
4482        alphabet: tuple[str, ...],
4483        transitions: list[dict[str, int]],
4484        accepting: set[int],
4485        start: int = 0,
4486    ):
4487        """Initialize a DFA from its alphabet and transition table.
4488
4489        Args:
4490            alphabet: Non-empty tuple of supported input characters.
4491            transitions: Transition table mapping characters to
4492                destination state indices for each state.
4493            accepting: Set of accepting state indices.
4494            start: Index of the initial state. Defaults to 0.
4495
4496        Raises:
4497            ValueError: If the alphabet is empty.
4498        """
4499        if not alphabet:
4500            raise ValueError("The DFA alphabet cannot be empty")
4501        self.alphabet = alphabet
4502        self.transitions = transitions
4503        self.accepting = accepting
4504        self.start = start
4505
4506    @classmethod
4507    def from_regex(cls, regex: Regex, alphabet: str) -> DFA:
4508        """Construct a DFA from a compiled regular expression.
4509
4510        Converts the supported regular expression into a deterministic
4511        finite automaton over the supplied alphabet.
4512
4513        The alphabet must contain single characters. Duplicate
4514        characters are removed while preserving their order.
4515
4516        Backreferences, conditional groups, and unsupported
4517        lookarounds cannot be converted.
4518
4519        Args:
4520            regex: Compiled Regex object to convert.
4521            alphabet: Characters supported by the resulting DFA.
4522
4523        Returns:
4524            A DFA representing the supported pattern behavior
4525            over the supplied alphabet.
4526
4527        Raises:
4528            ValueError: If the alphabet is empty or invalid, or if
4529                the pattern contains unsupported constructs.
4530            RegexComplexityError: If the alphabet or resulting
4531                automaton exceeds configured limits.
4532        """
4533        symbols = tuple(dict.fromkeys(alphabet))
4534        if not symbols:
4535            raise ValueError("The DFA alphabet cannot be empty")
4536        if any(len(symbol) != 1 for symbol in symbols):
4537            raise ValueError("The DFA alphabet must contain single characters")
4538        if len(symbols) > regex.limits.dfa_alphabet:
4539            raise RegexComplexityError(
4540                f"DFA alphabets are limited to {regex.limits.dfa_alphabet} characters"
4541            )
4542        if regex._has_backreferences:
4543            raise ValueError("Backreference patterns cannot be converted to a DFA")
4544        if regex._has_conditionals:
4545            raise ValueError("Conditional groups cannot be converted to a DFA")
4546        for lookaround in regex._dfa_lookarounds.values():
4547            if _single_character_predicate(lookaround.node) is None:
4548                raise ValueError(
4549                    "DFA conversion supports only single-character lookarounds"
4550                )
4551
4552        def is_word(char: str, ascii_only: bool) -> bool:
4553            if regex.flags & LOCALE and not ascii_only:
4554                return _locale_character_predicate(rb"\w")(char)
4555            return (
4556                char == "_" or char.isascii() and char.isalnum()
4557                if ascii_only
4558                else _is_word_char(char)
4559            )
4560
4561        def assertion_matches(
4562            kind: str,
4563            *,
4564            at_start: bool,
4565            at_end: bool,
4566            previous_newline: bool,
4567            previous_word: bool,
4568            previous_ascii_word: bool,
4569            previous_char: str | None,
4570            next_char: str | None,
4571        ) -> bool:
4572            lookaround = regex._dfa_lookarounds.get(kind)
4573            if lookaround is not None:
4574                predicate = _single_character_predicate(lookaround.node)
4575                if predicate is None:
4576                    raise RuntimeError("Unsupported lookaround reached DFA closure")
4577                char = next_char if lookaround.kind == "ahead" else previous_char
4578                matched = char is not None and predicate(char)
4579                return matched if lookaround.positive else not matched
4580            if kind in ("start", "absolute_start"):
4581                return at_start
4582            if kind == "start_multiline":
4583                return at_start or previous_newline
4584            if kind == "absolute_end":
4585                return at_end
4586            if kind == "end":
4587                return at_end or next_char == "\n"
4588            if kind == "end_multiline":
4589                return at_end or next_char == "\n"
4590            if kind in (
4591                "word_boundary",
4592                "not_word_boundary",
4593                "word_boundary_ascii",
4594                "not_word_boundary_ascii",
4595                "word_boundary_locale",
4596                "not_word_boundary_locale",
4597            ):
4598                ascii_only = kind.endswith("_ascii")
4599                left = (
4600                    previous_ascii_word
4601                    if ascii_only
4602                    else previous_word
4603                )
4604                right = next_char is not None and is_word(next_char, ascii_only)
4605                boundary = left != right
4606                positive = kind.startswith("word_boundary")
4607                if not positive and at_start and at_end:
4608                    return False
4609                return boundary if positive else not boundary
4610            return False
4611
4612        def closure(
4613            states: frozenset[int],
4614            *,
4615            at_start: bool,
4616            at_end: bool,
4617            previous_newline: bool,
4618            previous_word: bool,
4619            previous_ascii_word: bool,
4620            previous_char: str | None,
4621            next_char: str | None,
4622        ) -> frozenset[int]:
4623            reached = set(states)
4624            pending = list(states)
4625            while pending:
4626                state_id = pending.pop()
4627                state = regex._states[state_id]
4628                for kind, target, _ in state.epsilon:
4629                    if kind in ("epsilon", "save_start", "save_end") and target not in reached:
4630                        reached.add(target)
4631                        pending.append(target)
4632                for kind, target in state.assertions:
4633                    if assertion_matches(
4634                        kind,
4635                        at_start=at_start,
4636                        at_end=at_end,
4637                        previous_newline=previous_newline,
4638                        previous_word=previous_word,
4639                        previous_ascii_word=previous_ascii_word,
4640                        previous_char=previous_char,
4641                        next_char=next_char,
4642                    ) and target not in reached:
4643                        reached.add(target)
4644                        pending.append(target)
4645            return frozenset(reached)
4646
4647        initial: _DFAState = (
4648            frozenset({regex._start}),
4649            True,
4650            False,
4651            False,
4652            False,
4653            None,
4654        )
4655        states: list[_DFAState] = [initial]
4656        indices: dict[_DFAState, int] = {initial: 0}
4657        transitions: list[dict[str, int]] = []
4658        accepting: set[int] = set()
4659        cursor = 0
4660
4661        while cursor < len(states):
4662            (
4663                subset,
4664                at_start,
4665                previous_newline,
4666                previous_word,
4667                previous_ascii_word,
4668                previous_char,
4669            ) = states[cursor]
4670            row: dict[str, int] = {}
4671            final_closure = closure(
4672                subset,
4673                at_start=at_start,
4674                at_end=True,
4675                previous_newline=previous_newline,
4676                previous_word=previous_word,
4677                previous_ascii_word=previous_ascii_word,
4678                previous_char=previous_char,
4679                next_char=None,
4680            )
4681            if regex._accept in final_closure:
4682                accepting.add(cursor)
4683            for symbol in symbols:
4684                active = closure(
4685                    subset,
4686                    at_start=at_start,
4687                    at_end=False,
4688                    previous_newline=previous_newline,
4689                    previous_word=previous_word,
4690                    previous_ascii_word=previous_ascii_word,
4691                    previous_char=previous_char,
4692                    next_char=symbol,
4693                )
4694                destinations = {
4695                    target
4696                    for state_id in active
4697                    for predicate, _, target in regex._states[state_id].transitions
4698                    if predicate(symbol)
4699                }
4700                target_state: _DFAState = (
4701                    frozenset(destinations),
4702                    False,
4703                    symbol == "\n",
4704                    is_word(symbol, False),
4705                    is_word(symbol, True),
4706                    symbol,
4707                )
4708                if target_state not in indices:
4709                    if len(states) >= regex.limits.dfa_states:
4710                        raise RegexComplexityError(
4711                            f"DFAs are limited to {regex.limits.dfa_states} states"
4712                        )
4713                    indices[target_state] = len(states)
4714                    states.append(target_state)
4715                row[symbol] = indices[target_state]
4716            transitions.append(row)
4717            cursor += 1
4718        return cls(symbols, transitions, accepting)
4719
4720    def fullmatch(self, text: str) -> bool:
4721        """Check whether the entire input string is accepted.
4722
4723        Processes every character using the DFA transition table.
4724        If a character is outside the alphabet or has no available
4725        transition, matching fails.
4726
4727        Args:
4728            text: Input string to evaluate.
4729
4730        Returns:
4731            True if the entire input reaches an accepting state,
4732            otherwise False.
4733        """
4734        state = self.start
4735        for char in text:
4736            if char not in self.transitions[state]:
4737                return False
4738            state = self.transitions[state][char]
4739        return state in self.accepting
4740
4741    def minimize(self) -> DFA:
4742        """Return an equivalent DFA with fewer states where possible.
4743
4744        Uses Hopcroft's partition-refinement algorithm to combine
4745        equivalent accepting and non-accepting states.
4746
4747        The original DFA is not modified.
4748
4749        Returns:
4750            A new minimized DFA with the same alphabet and
4751            equivalent accepted language.
4752        """
4753        all_states = set(range(len(self.transitions)))
4754        partitions = [block for block in (self.accepting, all_states - self.accepting) if block]
4755        work = [min(partitions, key=len)]
4756
4757        while work:
4758            splitter = work.pop()
4759            for symbol in self.alphabet:
4760                predecessors = {
4761                    state
4762                    for state, row in enumerate(self.transitions)
4763                    if row[symbol] in splitter
4764                }
4765                for block in partitions.copy():
4766                    inside = block & predecessors
4767                    outside = block - predecessors
4768                    if not inside or not outside:
4769                        continue
4770                    partitions.remove(block)
4771                    partitions.extend((inside, outside))
4772                    if block in work:
4773                        work.remove(block)
4774                        work.extend((inside, outside))
4775                    else:
4776                        work.append(inside if len(inside) <= len(outside) else outside)
4777
4778        state_to_block = {
4779            state: block_index
4780            for block_index, block in enumerate(partitions)
4781            for state in block
4782        }
4783        minimized_transitions = [
4784            {
4785                symbol: state_to_block[self.transitions[next(iter(block))][symbol]]
4786                for symbol in self.alphabet
4787            }
4788            for block in partitions
4789        ]
4790        minimized_accepting = {
4791            state_to_block[state] for state in self.accepting
4792        }
4793        return DFA(
4794            self.alphabet,
4795            minimized_transitions,
4796            minimized_accepting,
4797            state_to_block[self.start],
4798        )
4799
4800    def to_dot(self) -> str:
4801        """Export the DFA as a Graphviz DOT description.
4802
4803        The generated graph represents DFA states, transitions,
4804        the initial state, and accepting states.
4805
4806        The output can be rendered using Graphviz-compatible tools.
4807
4808        Returns:
4809            A string containing the Graphviz DOT representation.
4810        """
4811        lines = ["digraph DFA {", "  rankdir=LR;", '  node [shape=circle];']
4812        lines.append(f'  start [shape=point]; start -> {self.start};')
4813        for state_id, row in enumerate(self.transitions):
4814            shape = "doublecircle" if state_id in self.accepting else "circle"
4815            lines.append(f'  {state_id} [shape={shape}, label="{state_id}"];')
4816            for symbol, target in row.items():
4817                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(symbol)}];")
4818        lines.append("}")
4819        return "\n".join(lines)

Construct a DFA from a compiled regular expression.

Converts the supported regular expression into a deterministic finite automaton over the supplied alphabet.

The alphabet must contain single characters. Duplicate characters are removed while preserving their order.

Backreferences, conditional groups, and unsupported lookarounds cannot be converted.

Args: regex: Compiled Regex object to convert. alphabet: Characters supported by the resulting DFA.

4741    def minimize(self) -> DFA:
4742        """Return an equivalent DFA with fewer states where possible.
4743
4744        Uses Hopcroft's partition-refinement algorithm to combine
4745        equivalent accepting and non-accepting states.
4746
4747        The original DFA is not modified.
4748
4749        Returns:
4750            A new minimized DFA with the same alphabet and
4751            equivalent accepted language.
4752        """
4753        all_states = set(range(len(self.transitions)))
4754        partitions = [block for block in (self.accepting, all_states - self.accepting) if block]
4755        work = [min(partitions, key=len)]
4756
4757        while work:
4758            splitter = work.pop()
4759            for symbol in self.alphabet:
4760                predecessors = {
4761                    state
4762                    for state, row in enumerate(self.transitions)
4763                    if row[symbol] in splitter
4764                }
4765                for block in partitions.copy():
4766                    inside = block & predecessors
4767                    outside = block - predecessors
4768                    if not inside or not outside:
4769                        continue
4770                    partitions.remove(block)
4771                    partitions.extend((inside, outside))
4772                    if block in work:
4773                        work.remove(block)
4774                        work.extend((inside, outside))
4775                    else:
4776                        work.append(inside if len(inside) <= len(outside) else outside)
4777
4778        state_to_block = {
4779            state: block_index
4780            for block_index, block in enumerate(partitions)
4781            for state in block
4782        }
4783        minimized_transitions = [
4784            {
4785                symbol: state_to_block[self.transitions[next(iter(block))][symbol]]
4786                for symbol in self.alphabet
4787            }
4788            for block in partitions
4789        ]
4790        minimized_accepting = {
4791            state_to_block[state] for state in self.accepting
4792        }
4793        return DFA(
4794            self.alphabet,
4795            minimized_transitions,
4796            minimized_accepting,
4797            state_to_block[self.start],
4798        )

Returns: A new minimized DFA with the same alphabet and equivalent accepted language.

def to_dot(self) -> str: 
4800    def to_dot(self) -> str:
4801        """Export the DFA as a Graphviz DOT description.
4802
4803        The generated graph represents DFA states, transitions,
4804        the initial state, and accepting states.
4805
4806        The output can be rendered using Graphviz-compatible tools.
4807
4808        Returns:
4809            A string containing the Graphviz DOT representation.
4810        """
4811        lines = ["digraph DFA {", "  rankdir=LR;", '  node [shape=circle];']
4812        lines.append(f'  start [shape=point]; start -> {self.start};')
4813        for state_id, row in enumerate(self.transitions):
4814            shape = "doublecircle" if state_id in self.accepting else "circle"
4815            lines.append(f'  {state_id} [shape={shape}, label="{state_id}"];')
4816            for symbol, target in row.items():
4817                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(symbol)}];")
4818        lines.append("}")
4819        return "\n".join(lines)

2266class Regex:
2267    """Compile and execute regular expressions.
2268
2269    Regex objects represent compiled patterns and can be reused for
2270    searching, matching, finding multiple matches, and substitutions.
2271
2272    The engine uses an ordered Thompson NFA for supported patterns
2273    and a bounded backtracking virtual machine for features requiring
2274    backtracking.
2275
2276    Patterns may be strings or bytes. Matching behavior can be
2277    configured using flags and resource limits.
2278
2279    Args:
2280        pattern: Regular expression pattern to compile.
2281        flags: Optional compilation flags.
2282        limits: Optional resource limits controlling compilation
2283            and matching complexity.
2284
2285    Raises:
2286        TypeError: If the pattern, flags, or limits have invalid types.
2287        ValueError: If incompatible or unsupported flags are supplied.
2288        RegexSyntaxError: If the pattern contains invalid syntax.
2289        RegexComplexityError: If a configured complexity limit is exceeded.
2290    """
2291
2292    def __init__(
2293        self, pattern: str | bytes, flags: int = 0, limits: RegexLimits | None = None
2294    ):
2295        if not isinstance(pattern, (str, bytes)):
2296            raise TypeError("pattern must be a string or bytes")
2297        if not isinstance(flags, int):
2298            raise TypeError("flags must be an integer")
2299        supported_flags = (
2300            IGNORECASE
2301            | MULTILINE
2302            | DOTALL
2303            | VERBOSE
2304            | ASCII
2305            | UNICODE
2306            | DEBUG
2307            | LOCALE
2308        )
2309        if flags & ~supported_flags:
2310            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported regex flags: {flags & ~supported_flags!r}")
2311        self._bytes_mode = isinstance(pattern, bytes)
2312        if self._bytes_mode and flags & UNICODE:
2313            raise ValueError("Unicode matching is not supported for bytes patterns")
2314        if flags & LOCALE and not self._bytes_mode:
2315            raise ValueError("LOCALE flag is only supported for bytes patterns")
2316        if flags & LOCALE and flags & (ASCII | UNICODE):
2317            raise ValueError("LOCALE is incompatible with ASCII and UNICODE flags")
2318        if flags & ASCII and flags & UNICODE:
2319            raise ValueError("ASCII and UNICODE flags are incompatible")
2320        self.limits = limits or RegexLimits()
2321        if not isinstance(self.limits, RegexLimits):
2322            raise TypeError("limits must be a RegexLimits instance")
2323        if len(pattern) > self.limits.pattern_length:
2324            raise RegexComplexityError(
2325                f"Patterns are limited to {self.limits.pattern_length} characters"
2326            )
2327        self.pattern = pattern

2329            pattern.decode("latin-1") if isinstance(pattern, bytes) else pattern
2330        )
2331        parser_flags = flags

2333            parser_flags |= ASCII
2334        elif not self._bytes_mode and not parser_flags & ASCII:
2335            parser_flags |= UNICODE

2339        except RegexSyntaxError as error:
2340            error.pattern = pattern
2341            raise
2342        self.flags = parser.compiled_flags
2343        if self._bytes_mode and not flags & ASCII:
2344            self.flags &= ~ASCII
2345        self.groups = parser.group_count
2346        self.groupindex = dict(parser.groupindex)
2347        atomic_nodes = _atomic_nodes(self._syntax)
2348        self._atomic_group_indices = {
2349            id(node): self.groups + index + 1
2350            for index, node in enumerate(atomic_nodes)
2351        }
2352        self._capture_count = self.groups + len(atomic_nodes)
2353        self._has_conditionals = _contains_conditional(self._syntax)
2354        self._has_lookarounds = _contains_lookaround(self._syntax)

2363            and not self.flags & IGNORECASE

2368        )

2375            or _contains_nullable_alternative_repeat(self._syntax)
2376        )
2377        self._states: list[_State] = []
2378        fragment = self._compile(self._syntax)
2379        self._start = fragment.start
2380        self._accept = fragment.end
2381        self._first_char_predicate = _first_character_predicate(self._syntax)
2382        self._first_char_literals = (
2383            None
2384            if parser.has_scoped_flags
2385            or self.flags & LOCALE
2386            or _nullable(self._syntax)
2387            else _first_character_literals(self._syntax)
2388        )
2389        self._lazy_dfa_enabled = (
2390            self.groups == 0
2391            and not self._has_backreferences
2392            and not self._requires_vm
2393            and not any(state.assertions for state in self._states)
2394        )
2395        self._lazy_dfa_lock = RLock()
2396        self._lazy_dfa_subsets: list[frozenset[int]] = []
2397        self._lazy_dfa_indices: dict[frozenset[int], int] = {}
2398        self._lazy_dfa_transitions: dict[tuple[int, str], int] = {}
2399        self._lazy_dfa_characters: set[str] = set()
2400        if self._lazy_dfa_enabled:
2401            initial = self._lazy_dfa_closure({self._start})
2402            self._lazy_dfa_subsets.append(initial)
2403            self._lazy_dfa_indices[initial] = 0
2404        self._vm: list[_Instruction] | None = None
2405        self._vm_entry = 0
2406        if self._literal is None or self._requires_vm:
2407            self._vm_entry, self._vm = self._compile_vm()
2408        self._preserve_repeat_history = self._capture_count > 0 or (
2409            self._vm is not None
2410            and any(isinstance(item, _AssertInstruction) for item in self._vm)
2411            and any(
2412                isinstance(item, _SplitInstruction)
2413                and item.repeat_id is not None
2414                and item.body_branch == 1
2415                for item in self._vm
2416            )
2417        )
2418        if flags & DEBUG:
2419            print(self.to_dot())
2420
2421    @classmethod
2422    def __class_getitem__(cls, item: object) -> type[Regex]:
2423        del item
2424        return cls
2425
2426    def __repr__(self) -> str:
2427        flags = self.flags & ~UNICODE
2428        flag_repr = "" if not flags else f", {RegexFlag(flags)!r}"
2429        return f"re.compile({self.pattern!r}{flag_repr})"
2430
2431    @staticmethod
2432    def _find_simple_backreference_tail(
2433        node: object,
2434    ) -> tuple[int, _Predicate] | None:
2435        items = node.items if isinstance(node, _Sequence) else (node,)
2436        if (
2437            len(items) != 3
2438            or not isinstance(items[0], _Group)
2439            or not isinstance(items[1], _Backreference)
2440            or items[1].group != items[0].index
2441            or not isinstance(items[2], _Assertion)
2442            or items[2].kind != "end"
2443        ):
2444            return None
2445        repeated = items[0].node
2446        if (
2447            not isinstance(repeated, _Repeat)
2448            or repeated.minimum != 1
2449            or repeated.maximum is not None
2450            or not repeated.greedy
2451            or not isinstance(repeated.node, _Character)
2452        ):
2453            return None
2454        return items[0].index, repeated.node.predicate
2455
2456    def _simple_backreference_match(
2457        self,
2458        text: str,
2459        start: int,
2460        limit: int,
2461        match_pos: int,
2462        match_string: str | bytes,
2463        *,
2464        fullmatch: bool = False,
2465    ) -> Match | None:
2466        if self._simple_backreference_tail is None:
2467            return None
2468        group, predicate = self._simple_backreference_tail
2469        ends = (limit,) if fullmatch else (
2470            (limit, limit - 1)
2471            if limit > 0 and text[limit - 1] == "\n"
2472            else (limit,)
2473        )
2474        for end in ends:
2475            length = end - start
2476            if length <= 0 or length % 2:
2477                continue
2478            capture_end = start + length // 2
2479            captured = text[start:capture_end]
2480            candidate = text[capture_end:end]
2481            equal = (
2482                all(
2483                    _case_insensitive_equal(
2484                        left,
2485                        right,
2486                        bool(self.flags & ASCII),
2487                        bool(self.flags & LOCALE),
2488                    )
2489                    for left, right in zip(captured, candidate)
2490                )
2491                if self.flags & IGNORECASE
2492                else captured == candidate
2493            )
2494            if all(predicate(char) for char in captured) and equal:
2495                captures: list[tuple[int, int] | None] = [None] * self.groups
2496                captures[group - 1] = (start, capture_end)
2497                return self._make_match(
2498                    text,
2499                    start,
2500                    end,
2501                    tuple(captures),
2502                    group,
2503                    match_pos,
2504                    limit,
2505                    match_string,
2506                )
2507        return None
2508
2509    def __copy__(self) -> Regex:
2510        return self
2511
2512    def __deepcopy__(self, memo: dict[int, object]) -> Regex:
2513        memo[id(self)] = self
2514        return self
2515
2516    def __reduce__(
2517        self,
2518    ) -> tuple[Callable[..., Regex], tuple[str | bytes, int, RegexLimits]]:
2519        return Regex, (self.pattern, self.flags, self.limits)
2520
2521    def _prepare_text(self, text: str | bytes) -> tuple[str, str | bytes]:
2522        if self._bytes_mode:
2523            if not isinstance(text, (bytes, bytearray, memoryview)):
2524                raise TypeError("cannot use a bytes pattern on a string")
2525            byte_text = bytes(text)
2526            return byte_text.decode("latin-1"), byte_text
2527        if not isinstance(text, str):
2528            raise TypeError("cannot use a string pattern on a bytes-like object")
2529        return text, text
2530
2531    def _lazy_dfa_closure(self, states: set[int]) -> frozenset[int]:
2532        reached = set(states)
2533        pending = list(states)
2534        while pending:
2535            state_id = pending.pop()
2536            for kind, target, _ in self._states[state_id].epsilon:
2537                if kind == "epsilon" and target not in reached:
2538                    reached.add(target)
2539                    pending.append(target)
2540        return frozenset(reached)
2541
2542    def _lazy_dfa_fullmatch(self, text: str, pos: int, endpos: int) -> bool | None:
2543        state_id = 0
2544        for char in text[pos:endpos]:
2545            key = (state_id, char)
2546            with self._lazy_dfa_lock:
2547                target_id = self._lazy_dfa_transitions.get(key)
2548                if target_id is None:
2549                    if char not in self._lazy_dfa_characters:
2550                        if len(self._lazy_dfa_characters) >= self.limits.dfa_alphabet:
2551                            return None
2552                        self._lazy_dfa_characters.add(char)
2553                    sources = self._lazy_dfa_subsets[state_id]
2554                    destinations = {
2555                        target
2556                        for source in sources
2557                        for predicate, _, target in self._states[source].transitions
2558                        if predicate(char)
2559                    }
2560                    subset = self._lazy_dfa_closure(destinations)
2561                    target_id = self._lazy_dfa_indices.get(subset)
2562                    if target_id is None:
2563                        if len(self._lazy_dfa_subsets) >= self.limits.dfa_states:
2564                            return None
2565                        target_id = len(self._lazy_dfa_subsets)
2566                        self._lazy_dfa_indices[subset] = target_id
2567                        self._lazy_dfa_subsets.append(subset)
2568                    self._lazy_dfa_transitions[key] = target_id
2569            state_id = target_id
2570        return self._accept in self._lazy_dfa_subsets[state_id]
2571
2572    def search(
2573        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2574    ) -> Match | None:
2575        """Search the input for the first matching substring.
2576
2577        The search begins at ``pos`` and stops at ``endpos``.
2578        If omitted, ``endpos`` defaults to the end of the input.
2579
2580        Args:
2581            text: String or bytes input to search.
2582            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
2583            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
2584
2585        Returns:
2586            A Match object for the first match, or None if no match exists.
2587
2588        Raises:
2589            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
2590        """
2591        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
2592        pos, endpos = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
2593        return self._search_from(
2594            text, pos, endpos=endpos, match_string=match_string
2595        )
2596
2597    def explain(
2598        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2599    ) -> str:
2600        """Explain how the engine processes a search operation.
2601
2602        Provides a textual trace describing the selected matching
2603        engine, search bounds, candidate positions, and matching
2604        decisions.
2605
2606        This is intended for debugging and understanding why a
2607        pattern matched or failed to match.
2608
2609        Args:
2610            text: String or bytes input to search.
2611            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
2612            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
2613
2614        Returns:
2615            A textual explanation of the search process.
2616
2617        Raises:
2618            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
2619        """
2620        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
2621        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
2622        events = [
2623            f"Pattern: {self.pattern!r}",
2624            f"Input length: {len(text)}",
2625            f"Search bounds: [{pos}, {limit})",
2626            "Matcher: "
2627            + (
2628                "backtracking VM"
2629                if self._requires_vm
2630                else "ordered Thompson NFA"
2631                if self._literal is None
2632                else "literal search"
2633            ),
2634        ]
2635        match = self._search_from(
2636            text,
2637            pos,
2638            endpos=limit,
2639            match_string=match_string,
2640            trace=events,
2641        )
2642        if match is None:
2643            events.append("Result: no match.")
2644        else:
2645            events.append(f"Result: matched span {match.span()}.")
2646            for name, value in match.groupdict().items():
2647                events.append(f"  Group {name!r}: {value!r}")
2648            if self.groups:
2649                for index, value in enumerate(match.groups(), 1):
2650                    events.append(f"  Group {index}: {value!r}")
2651        return "\n".join(events)
2652
2653    def _make_match(
2654        self,
2655        text: str,
2656        start: int,
2657        end: int,
2658        captures: tuple[tuple[int, int] | None, ...] = (),
2659        lastindex: int | None = None,
2660        pos: int = 0,
2661        endpos: int | None = None,
2662        match_string: str | bytes | None = None,
2663    ) -> Match:
2664        return Match(
2665            text if match_string is None else match_string,
2666            start,
2667            end,
2668            captures,
2669            lastindex,
2670            self.groupindex,
2671            self,
2672            pos,
2673            len(text) if endpos is None else endpos,
2674            self.groups,
2675        )
2676
2677    def _required_text_is_present(self, text: str, start: int, end: int) -> bool:
2678        if (
2679            self._literal is not None
2680            or self.flags & IGNORECASE
2681            or not self._required_literals
2682        ):
2683            return True
2684        return all(
2685            text.find(literal, start, end) >= 0
2686            for literal in self._required_literals
2687        )
2688
2689    def _search_from(
2690        self,
2691        text: str,
2692        position: int,
2693        *,
2694        endpos: int | None = None,
2695        reject_empty_at: int | None = None,
2696        match_string: str | bytes | None = None,
2697        trace: list[str] | None = None,
2698    ) -> Match | None:
2699        limit = len(text) if endpos is None else endpos
2700        if position > limit or limit < 0:
2701            _record_explanation(trace, "Search bounds contain no candidate positions.")
2702            return None
2703        if not self._required_text_is_present(text, position, limit):
2704            if trace is not None:
2705                missing_literals = [
2706                    literal
2707                    for literal in self._required_literals
2708                    if text.find(literal, position, limit) < 0
2709                ]
2710                for literal in sorted(missing_literals):
2711                    _record_explanation(
2712                        trace,
2713                        f"Required literal {literal!r} is absent from the searched bounds.",
2714                    )
2715                if not missing_literals:
2716                    _record_explanation(
2717                        trace,
2718                        "A required literal is absent from the searched input; matching was skipped.",
2719                    )
2720            return None
2721        if self._literal is not None:
2722            if self._literal == "":
2723                start = position + (position == reject_empty_at)
2724                _record_explanation(
2725                    trace,
2726                    f"Empty literal matched at position {start}."
2727                    if start <= limit
2728                    else "The only empty match was rejected at the end of the search bounds.",
2729                )
2730                return (
2731                    None
2732                    if start > limit
2733                    else self._make_match(
2734                        text,
2735                        start,
2736                        start,
2737                        pos=position,
2738                        endpos=limit,
2739                        match_string=match_string,
2740                    )
2741                )
2742            start = text.find(self._literal, position, limit)
2743            _record_explanation(
2744                trace,
2745                f"Literal {self._literal!r} "
2746                + (
2747                    f"was found at position {start}."
2748                    if start >= 0
2749                    else "does not occur in the searched bounds."
2750                ),
2751            )
2752            return (
2753                None
2754                if start < 0
2755                else self._make_match(
2756                    text,
2757                    start,
2758                    start + len(self._literal),
2759                    pos=position,
2760                    endpos=limit,
2761                    match_string=match_string,
2762                )
2763            )
2764        if self._simple_backreference_tail is not None:
2765            for start in range(position, limit + 1):
2766                if trace is not None:
2767                    _record_explanation(trace, f"Trying candidate start {start}.")
2768                result = self._simple_backreference_match(
2769                    text, start, limit, position, match_string or text
2770                )
2771                if result is not None:
2772                    _record_explanation(trace, "The captured text equals the required backreference.")
2773                    return result
2774            _record_explanation(trace, "No candidate satisfied the backreference.")
2775            return None
2776        if self._requires_vm:
2777            budget = [0]
2778            first_char_candidates = self._first_char_literals
2779            if first_char_candidates is not None and self.flags & IGNORECASE:
2780                first_char_candidates = {
2781                    candidate
2782                    for literal in first_char_candidates
2783                    for candidate in _case_equivalent_characters(
2784                        literal, bool(self.flags & ASCII) or self._bytes_mode
2785                    )
2786                }
2787            for start in range(position, limit + 1):
2788                if (
2789                    first_char_candidates is not None
2790                    and (
2791                        start >= limit
2792                        or text[start] not in first_char_candidates
2793                    )
2794                ):
2795                    if trace is not None:
2796                        _record_explanation(
2797                            trace,
2798                            f"Candidate start {start} skipped because its first "
2799                            "character cannot match.",
2800                        )
2801                    continue
2802                if trace is not None:
2803                    _record_explanation(trace, f"Trying candidate start {start}.")
2804                result = self._run_vm(
2805                    text,
2806                    start,
2807                    False,
2808                    budget,
2809                    search_end=limit,
2810                    reject_empty=start == reject_empty_at,
2811                    match_pos=position,
2812                    match_string=match_string,
2813                    trace=trace,
2814                )
2815                if result is not None:
2816                    return result
2817            _record_explanation(trace, "All candidate starts failed.")
2818            return None
2819        if len(self._states) <= 256:
2820            _record_explanation(trace, "Running the ordered NFA from the search position.")
2821            return self._run_nfa(
2822                text,
2823                position,
2824                search=True,
2825                fullmatch=False,
2826                search_end=limit,
2827                match_pos=position,
2828                reject_empty_at=reject_empty_at,
2829                match_string=match_string,
2830                trace=trace,
2831            )
2832        for start in range(position, limit + 1):
2833            if trace is not None:
2834                _record_explanation(trace, f"Trying candidate start {start}.")
2835            result = self._run_nfa(
2836                text,
2837                start,
2838                search=False,
2839                fullmatch=False,
2840                search_end=limit,
2841                match_pos=position,
2842                reject_empty_at=start if start == reject_empty_at else None,
2843                match_string=match_string,
2844                trace=trace,
2845            )
2846            if result is not None:
2847                return result
2848        _record_explanation(trace, "All candidate starts failed.")
2849        return None
2850
2851    def match(
2852        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2853    ) -> Match | None:
2854        """Match the pattern at the specified starting position.
2855
2856        Unlike search(), this method only attempts a match at ``pos``.
2857        It does not scan later positions in the input.
2858
2859        Args:
2860            text: String or bytes input to match against.
2861            pos: Position at which matching begins. Defaults to 0.
2862            endpos: Optional ending position of the matching region.
2863
2864        Returns:
2865            A Match object if the pattern matches at ``pos``,
2866            or None otherwise.
2867
2868        Raises:
2869            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
2870        """
2871        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
2872        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
2873        if pos > limit:
2874            return None
2875        if not self._required_text_is_present(text, pos, limit):
2876            return None
2877        if self._literal is not None:
2878            if not text.startswith(self._literal, pos, limit):
2879                return None
2880            return self._make_match(
2881                text,
2882                pos,
2883                pos + len(self._literal),
2884                pos=pos,
2885                endpos=limit,
2886                match_string=match_string,
2887            )
2888        if self._simple_backreference_tail is not None:
2889            return self._simple_backreference_match(
2890                text, pos, limit, pos, match_string, fullmatch=False
2891            )
2892        if self._requires_vm:
2893            return self._run_vm(
2894                text,
2895                pos,
2896                False,
2897                [0],
2898                search_end=limit,
2899                match_pos=pos,
2900                match_string=match_string,
2901            )
2902        return self._run_nfa(
2903            text,
2904            pos,
2905            search=False,
2906            fullmatch=False,
2907            search_end=limit,
2908            match_pos=pos,
2909            match_string=match_string,
2910        )
2911
2912    def fullmatch(
2913        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2914    ) -> Match | None:
2915        """Check whether the entire specified input region matches.
2916
2917        The pattern must match from ``pos`` through ``endpos``.
2918        Unlike search(), this method does not accept a partial match.
2919
2920        Args:
2921            text: String or bytes input to match against.
2922            pos: Starting position of the matching region. Defaults to 0.
2923            endpos: Optional ending position of the matching region.
2924
2925        Returns:
2926            A Match object if the entire region matches, or None otherwise.
2927
2928        Raises:
2929            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
2930        """
2931        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
2932        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
2933        if pos > limit:
2934            return None
2935        if not self._required_text_is_present(text, pos, limit):
2936            return None
2937        if self._simple_backreference_tail is not None:
2938            return self._simple_backreference_match(
2939                text, pos, limit, pos, match_string, fullmatch=True
2940            )
2941        if self._lazy_dfa_enabled:
2942            matched = self._lazy_dfa_fullmatch(text, pos, limit)
2943            if matched is not None:
2944                return (
2945                    self._make_match(
2946                        text,
2947                        pos,
2948                        limit,
2949                        pos=pos,
2950                        endpos=limit,
2951                        match_string=match_string,
2952                    )
2953                    if matched
2954                    else None
2955                )
2956        if self._literal is not None:
2957            if text[pos:limit] != self._literal:
2958                return None
2959            return self._make_match(
2960                text, pos, limit, pos=pos, endpos=limit, match_string=match_string
2961            )
2962        if self._requires_vm:
2963            return self._run_vm(
2964                text,
2965                pos,
2966                True,
2967                [0],
2968                search_end=limit,
2969                match_pos=pos,
2970                match_string=match_string,
2971            )
2972        return self._run_nfa(
2973            text,
2974            pos,
2975            search=False,
2976            fullmatch=True,
2977            search_end=limit,
2978            match_pos=pos,
2979            match_string=match_string,
2980        )
2981
2982    def finditer(
2983        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2984    ) -> Iterator[Match]:
2985        """Return an iterator yielding Match objects for successive matches.
2986
2987        Matches are found from left to right within the specified input
2988        region. Empty matches are handled without repeatedly yielding
2989        the same empty match at one position.
2990
2991        Args:
2992            text: String or bytes input to search.
2993            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
2994            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
2995
2996        Returns:
2997            An iterator yielding Match objects.
2998
2999        Raises:
3000            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
3001        """
3002        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
3003        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
3004        position = pos
3005        reject_empty_at: int | None = None
3006        while position <= limit:
3007            match = self._search_from(
3008                text,
3009                position,
3010                endpos=limit,
3011                reject_empty_at=reject_empty_at,
3012                match_string=match_string,
3013            )
3014            if match is None:
3015                return
3016            yield match
3017            if match.start() == match.end():
3018                position = match.end()
3019                reject_empty_at = match.end()
3020            else:
3021                position = match.end()
3022                reject_empty_at = None
3023
3024    def findall(
3025        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
3026    ) -> list[str | bytes] | list[tuple[str | bytes, ...]]:
3027        """Return all non-overlapping matches as a list.
3028
3029        The returned values depend on the number of capturing groups:
3030        - No capturing groups: matched strings are returned.
3031        - One capturing group: the captured values are returned.
3032        - Multiple capturing groups: tuples of captured values are returned.
3033
3034        Unmatched optional groups are represented by an empty string
3035        or empty bytes value, depending on the pattern type.
3036
3037        Args:
3038            text: String or bytes input to search.
3039            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
3040            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
3041
3042        Returns:
3043            A list containing matched strings, bytes, or tuples of
3044            captured values.
3045        """
3046        empty = b"" if self._bytes_mode else ""
3047        if self.groups == 0:
3048            return [
3049                match.string[match.start() : match.end()]
3050                for match in self.finditer(text, pos, endpos)
3051            ]
3052        if self.groups == 1:
3053            return [
3054                value if value is not None else empty
3055                for match in self.finditer(text, pos, endpos)
3056                for value in match.groups()
3057            ]
3058        return [
3059            tuple(value if value is not None else empty for value in match.groups())
3060            for match in self.finditer(text, pos, endpos)
3061        ]
3062
3063    def subn(
3064        self,
3065        replacement: str | bytes | Callable[[Match], str | bytes],
3066        text: str | bytes,
3067        count: int = 0,
3068        pos: int = 0,
3069        endpos: int | None = None,
3070    ) -> tuple[str | bytes, int]:
3071        """Replace matches and return the resulting input and replacement count.
3072
3073        The replacement can be a string, bytes value, or callable.
3074        A callable receives each Match object and must return a value
3075        of the same type as the input.
3076
3077        Replacement templates support capture-group references.
3078
3079        Args:
3080            replacement: Replacement template or callable.
3081            text: String or bytes input to process.
3082            count: Maximum number of replacements. Zero means unlimited.
3083            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
3084            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
3085
3086        Returns:
3087            A tuple containing the resulting input and the number
3088            of substitutions performed.
3089
3090        Raises:
3091            TypeError: If argument types are invalid or replacement
3092                results do not match the input type.
3093            ValueError: If count is negative.
3094        """
3095        _, source_text = self._prepare_text(text)
3096        if not isinstance(count, int):
3097            raise TypeError("count must be an integer")
3098        if count < 0:
3099            raise ValueError("count must be non-negative")
3100        if not isinstance(replacement, (str, bytes)) and not callable(replacement):
3101            raise TypeError("replacement must be a string, bytes, or callable")
3102        if self._bytes_mode != isinstance(replacement, bytes) and not callable(replacement):
3103            raise TypeError("replacement type must match the pattern type")
3104        template_parts = None
3105        if not callable(replacement):
3106            template = (
3107                replacement.decode("latin-1")
3108                if isinstance(replacement, bytes)
3109                else replacement
3110            )
3111            template_parts = _parse_template(template, self.groupindex, self.groups)
3112        pieces: list[str | bytes] = []
3113        cursor = 0
3114        substitutions = 0
3115        matches = iter(self.finditer(source_text, pos, endpos))
3116        while not count or substitutions < count:
3117            try:
3118                match = next(matches)
3119            except StopIteration:
3120                break
3121            pieces.append(source_text[cursor : match.start()])
3122            if callable(replacement):
3123                value = replacement(match)
3124            else:
3125                if template_parts is None:
3126                    raise RuntimeError("Replacement template was not parsed")
3127                expanded = _render_template(template_parts, match)
3128                value = (
3129                    expanded.encode("latin-1")
3130                    if isinstance(replacement, bytes)
3131                    else expanded
3132                )
3133            if not isinstance(value, type(source_text)):
3134                raise TypeError("replacement function must return the same type as the input")
3135            pieces.append(value)
3136            cursor = match.end()
3137            substitutions += 1
3138        pieces.append(source_text[cursor:])
3139        if isinstance(source_text, bytes):
3140            byte_pieces = [piece for piece in pieces if isinstance(piece, bytes)]
3141            if len(byte_pieces) != len(pieces):
3142                raise RuntimeError("Bytes substitution produced a non-bytes piece")
3143            return b"".join(byte_pieces), substitutions
3144        string_pieces = [piece for piece in pieces if isinstance(piece, str)]
3145        if len(string_pieces) != len(pieces):
3146            raise RuntimeError("String substitution produced a non-string piece")
3147        return "".join(string_pieces), substitutions
3148
3149    def sub(
3150        self,
3151        replacement: str | bytes | Callable[[Match], str | bytes],
3152        text: str | bytes,
3153        count: int = 0,
3154        pos: int = 0,
3155        endpos: int | None = None,
3156    ) -> str | bytes:
3157        """Replace matches and return the resulting input.
3158
3159        Accepts the same replacement templates and callable replacements
3160        as subn(), but returns only the resulting string or bytes value.
3161
3162        Args:
3163            replacement: Replacement template or callable.
3164            text: String or bytes input to process.
3165            count: Maximum number of replacements. Zero means unlimited.
3166            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
3167            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
3168
3169        Returns:
3170            The resulting string or bytes value.
3171        """
3172        return self.subn(replacement, text, count, pos, endpos)[0]
3173
3174    def split(
3175        self,
3176        text: str | bytes,
3177        maxsplit: int = 0,
3178        pos: int = 0,
3179        endpos: int | None = None,
3180    ) -> list[str | bytes | None]:
3181        """Split the input using occurrences of the compiled pattern.
3182
3183        Capturing groups in the pattern are included in the resulting
3184        list. Unmatched optional capturing groups may produce None.
3185
3186        Args:
3187            text: String or bytes input to split.
3188            maxsplit: Maximum number of splits. Zero means unlimited.
3189            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
3190            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
3191
3192        Returns:
3193            A list containing the resulting string or bytes segments
3194            and captured separator values.
3195        """
3196        _, source_text = self._prepare_text(text)
3197        if not isinstance(maxsplit, int):
3198            raise TypeError("maxsplit must be an integer")
3199        if maxsplit < 0:
3200            raise ValueError("maxsplit must be non-negative")
3201        pieces: list[str | bytes | None] = []
3202        cursor = 0
3203        splits = 0
3204        matches = iter(self.finditer(source_text, pos, endpos))
3205        while not maxsplit or splits < maxsplit:
3206            try:
3207                match = next(matches)
3208            except StopIteration:
3209                break
3210            pieces.append(source_text[cursor : match.start()])
3211            if self.groups:
3212                pieces.extend(match.groups())
3213            cursor = match.end()
3214            splits += 1
3215        pieces.append(source_text[cursor:])
3216        return pieces
3217
3218    def _run_nfa(
3219        self,
3220        text: str,
3221        initial_start: int,
3222        *,
3223        search: bool,
3224        fullmatch: bool,
3225        reject_empty_at: int | None = None,
3226        program: tuple[_Instruction, ...] | None = None,
3227        entry: int | None = None,
3228        initial_captures: tuple[tuple[int, int] | None, ...] | None = None,
3229        initial_lastindex: int | None = None,
3230        end_position: int | None = None,
3231        search_end: int | None = None,
3232        match_pos: int | None = None,
3233        match_string: str | bytes | None = None,
3234        look_cache: dict[tuple[int, int], tuple[bool, ...]] | None = None,
3235        trace: list[str] | None = None,
3236    ) -> Match | None:
3237        if program is None:
3238            if self._vm is None:
3239                raise RuntimeError("NFA matcher program was not compiled")
3240            instructions = tuple(self._vm)
3241        else:
3242            instructions = program
3243        start_pc = entry if entry is not None else self._vm_entry
3244        active: list[_Thread] = []
3245        pending: Match | None = None
3246        position = initial_start
3247        limit = len(text) if search_end is None else search_end
3248        match_start_pos = initial_start if match_pos is None else match_pos
3249        first_char_predicate = self._first_char_predicate if program is None else None
3250        empty_captures = initial_captures or (None,) * self._capture_count
3251        if look_cache is None:
3252            look_cache = {}
3253        first_char_literals = self._first_char_literals if program is None else None
3254        first_char_candidates = first_char_literals if search else None
3255        if (
3256            search
3257            and first_char_literals is not None
3258            and self.flags & IGNORECASE
3259        ):
3260            first_char_candidates = {
3261                candidate
3262                for literal in first_char_literals
3263                for candidate in _case_equivalent_characters(
3264                    literal, bool(self.flags & ASCII) or self._bytes_mode
3265                )
3266            }
3267
3268        while position <= limit:
3269            if trace is not None:
3270                _record_explanation(
3271                    trace,
3272                    f"At position {position}, {len(active)} consuming path(s) "
3273                    "are active.",
3274                )
3275            if (
3276                search
3277                and not active
3278                and pending is None
3279                and first_char_candidates is not None
3280            ):
3281                next_position = min(
3282                    (
3283                        found
3284                        for char in first_char_candidates
3285                        if (found := text.find(char, position, limit)) >= 0
3286                    ),
3287                    default=-1,
3288                )
3289                if next_position < 0:
3290                    _record_explanation(
3291                        trace,
3292                        "No remaining input character can start the pattern.",
3293                    )
3294                    return pending
3295                if trace is not None:
3296                    _record_explanation(
3297                        trace,
3298                        f"Skipped to possible first-character position {next_position}.",
3299                    )
3300                position = next_position
3301            seeds = list(active)
3302            if first_char_candidates is not None:
3303                can_start = (
3304                    position < limit and text[position] in first_char_candidates
3305                )
3306            else:
3307                can_start = (
3308                    first_char_predicate is None
3309                    or position < limit and first_char_predicate(text[position])
3310                )
3311            if (
3312                pending is None
3313                and (search or position == initial_start)
3314                and can_start
3315            ):
3316                seeds.append(
3317                    (
3318                        start_pc,
3319                        position,
3320                        empty_captures,
3321                        initial_lastindex,
3322                        (),
3323                        (),
3324                        (position,),
3325                    )
3326                )
3327            seeds = [
3328                (*thread[:6], (rank,))
3329                for rank, thread in enumerate(seeds)
3330            ]
3331            closure = self._closure_program(
3332                seeds,
3333                position,
3334                text,
3335                instructions,
3336                look_cache,
3337                limit,
3338                match_string,
3339                trace,
3340            )
3341
3342            accepted = next(
3343                (
3344                    index
3345                    for index, (pc, _, _, _, _, _, _) in enumerate(closure)
3346                    if isinstance(instructions[pc], _MatchInstruction)
3347                    and (not fullmatch or position == limit)
3348                    and (end_position is None or position == end_position)
3349                ),
3350                None,
3351            )
3352            if accepted is not None:
3353                _, match_start, captures, lastindex, _, _, _ = closure[accepted]
3354                if reject_empty_at == match_start and position == match_start:
3355                    _record_explanation(
3356                        trace,
3357                        f"Empty match at {position} was rejected to advance iteration.",
3358                    )
3359                    closure.pop(accepted)
3360                else:
3361                    _record_explanation(
3362                        trace,
3363                        f"An accepting path was reached for candidate start {match_start}.",
3364                    )
3365                    pending = self._make_match(
3366                        text,
3367                        match_start,
3368                        position,
3369                        captures,
3370                        lastindex,
3371                        match_start_pos,
3372                        limit,
3373                        match_string,
3374                    )
3375                    closure = closure[:accepted]
3376                    if not closure:
3377                        _record_explanation(
3378                            trace, "No higher-priority path can extend this match."
3379                        )
3380                        return pending
3381
3382            if (
3383                position == limit
3384                or (end_position is not None and position >= end_position)
3385            ):
3386                if pending is None:
3387                    _record_explanation(
3388                        trace,
3389                        f"Input ended at position {position} before an accepting path was reached.",
3390                    )
3391                return pending
3392            if not closure:
3393                if search and pending is None:
3394                    _record_explanation(
3395                        trace,
3396                        f"No NFA path survived at position {position}; trying the next start.",
3397                    )
3398                    position += 1
3399                    continue
3400                if pending is None:
3401                    _record_explanation(
3402                        trace,
3403                        f"No NFA path survived at position {position}.",
3404                    )
3405                return pending
3406
3407            next_threads: list[_Thread] = []
3408            char = text[position]
3409            for rank, (
3410                pc,
3411                match_start,
3412                captures,
3413                lastindex,
3414                repeat_starts,
3415                _,
3416                _,
3417            ) in enumerate(closure):
3418                instruction = instructions[pc]
3419                if (
3420                    isinstance(instruction, _CharInstruction)
3421                    and instruction.predicate(char)
3422                ):
3423                    next_threads.append(
3424                        (
3425                            instruction.target,
3426                            match_start,
3427                            captures,
3428                            lastindex,
3429                            repeat_starts,
3430                            (),
3431                            (rank,),
3432                        )
3433                    )
3434            active = next_threads
3435            if not active:
3436                _record_explanation(
3437                    trace,
3438                    f"No consuming path accepts character {char!r} at position {position}.",
3439                )
3440            position += 1
3441            if not active and (not search or pending is not None):
3442                return pending
3443        return pending
3444
3445    def _closure_program(
3446        self,
3447        seeds: list[_Thread],
3448        position: int,
3449        text: str,
3450        instructions: tuple[_Instruction, ...],
3451        look_cache: dict[tuple[int, int], tuple[bool, ...]],
3452        endpos: int,
3453        match_string: str | bytes | None,
3454        trace: list[str] | None = None,
3455    ) -> list[_Thread]:
3456        reached: set[_StateKey] = set()
3457        best_priorities: dict[_StateKey, tuple[int, ...]] = {}
3458        ordered: list[_Thread] = []
3459        sequence = count()
3460        pending: list[tuple[tuple[int, ...], int, _Thread]] = []
3461
3462        def state_key(
3463            pc: int,
3464            repeat_starts: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...],
3465            empty_guards: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...],
3466        ) -> _StateKey:
3467            if not self._preserve_repeat_history:
3468                guards = tuple(
3469                    (repeat_id, guard_position)
3470                    for repeat_id, guard_position in empty_guards
3471                    if guard_position == position
3472                )
3473                instruction = instructions[pc]
3474                if isinstance(instruction, _RepeatEndInstruction):
3475                    return (
3476                        pc,
3477                        guards,
3478                        any(
3479                            started_id == instruction.repeat_id
3480                            and started_at == position
3481                            for started_id, started_at in repeat_starts
3482                        ),
3483                    )
3484                return (pc, guards) if guards else pc
3485            return (
3486                pc,
3487                tuple(
3488                    (repeat_id, start)
3489                    for repeat_id, start in repeat_starts
3490                    if start == position
3491                ),
3492                tuple(
3493                    (repeat_id, guard_position)
3494                    for repeat_id, guard_position in empty_guards
3495                    if guard_position == position
3496                ),
3497            )
3498
3499        def push(
3500            pc: int,
3501            match_start: int,
3502            captures: tuple[tuple[int, int] | None, ...],
3503            lastindex: int | None,
3504            repeat_starts: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...],
3505            empty_guards: tuple[tuple[int, int], ...],
3506            priority: tuple[int, ...],
3507        ) -> None:
3508            key = state_key(pc, repeat_starts, empty_guards)
3509            current_priority = best_priorities.get(key)
3510            if current_priority is not None and current_priority <= priority:
3511                return
3512            best_priorities[key] = priority
3513            thread = (
3514                pc,
3515                match_start,
3516                captures,
3517                lastindex,
3518                repeat_starts,
3519                empty_guards,
3520                priority,
3521            )
3522            heapq.heappush(pending, (priority, next(sequence), thread))
3523
3524        for thread in seeds:
3525            push(*thread[:6], thread[6])
3526
3527        while pending:
3528            priority, _, thread = heapq.heappop(pending)
3529            (
3530                pc,
3531                match_start,
3532                captures,
3533                lastindex,
3534                repeat_starts,
3535                empty_guards,
3536                _,
3537            ) = thread
3538            instruction = instructions[pc]
3539            key = state_key(pc, repeat_starts, empty_guards)
3540            if best_priorities.get(key) != priority:
3541                continue
3542            if key in reached:
3543                continue
3544            reached.add(key)
3545            ordered.append(
3546                (
3547                    pc,
3548                    match_start,
3549                    captures,
3550                    lastindex,
3551                    repeat_starts,
3552                    empty_guards,
3553                    priority,
3554                )
3555            )
3556            if isinstance(instruction, _SplitInstruction):
3557                branches = list(enumerate(instruction.branches))
3558                if instruction.repeat_id is not None:
3559                    guarded = any(
3560                        repeat_id == instruction.repeat_id
3561                        and guard_position == position
3562                        for repeat_id, guard_position in empty_guards
3563                    )
3564                    if guarded:
3565                        if instruction.body_branch is None:
3566                            raise RuntimeError("Repeated split has no body branch")
3567                        branches = tuple(
3568                            (index, branch)
3569                            for index, branch in branches
3570                            if index != instruction.body_branch
3571                        )
3572                for index, branch in branches:
3573                    push(
3574                        branch,
3575                        match_start,
3576                        captures,
3577                        lastindex,
3578                        repeat_starts,
3579                        empty_guards,
3580                        priority + (index,),
3581                    )
3582            elif isinstance(instruction, _RepeatStartInstruction):
3583                starts = tuple(
3584                    (repeat_id, start)
3585                    for repeat_id, start in repeat_starts
3586                    if repeat_id != instruction.repeat_id
3587                ) + ((instruction.repeat_id, position),)
3588                push(
3589                    instruction.target,
3590                    match_start,
3591                    captures,
3592                    lastindex,
3593                    starts,
3594                    empty_guards,
3595                    priority,
3596                )
3597            elif isinstance(instruction, _RepeatEndInstruction):
3598                start = next(
3599                    (
3600                        start
3601                        for repeat_id, start in reversed(repeat_starts)
3602                        if repeat_id == instruction.repeat_id
3603                    ),
3604                    position,
3605                )
3606                starts = tuple(
3607                    (repeat_id, start_position)
3608                    for repeat_id, start_position in repeat_starts
3609                    if repeat_id != instruction.repeat_id
3610                )
3611                guards = empty_guards
3612                if start == position and not any(
3613                    repeat_id == instruction.repeat_id
3614                    and guard_position == position
3615                    for repeat_id, guard_position in guards
3616                ):
3617                    guards += ((instruction.repeat_id, position),)
3618                push(
3619                    instruction.target,
3620                    match_start,
3621                    captures,
3622                    lastindex,
3623                    starts,
3624                    guards,
3625                    priority,
3626                )
3627            elif isinstance(instruction, _SaveInstruction):
3628                updated = list(captures)
3629                current = updated[instruction.group - 1]
3630                updated[instruction.group - 1] = (
3631                    (position, -1)
3632                    if instruction.is_start
3633                    else (
3634                        current[0] if current is not None else position,
3635                        position,
3636                    )
3637                )
3638                push(
3639                    instruction.target,
3640                    match_start,
3641                    tuple(updated),
3642                    (
3643                        instruction.group
3644                        if not instruction.is_start
3645                        and instruction.group <= self.groups
3646                        else lastindex
3647                    ),
3648                    repeat_starts,
3649                    empty_guards,
3650                    priority,
3651                )
3652            elif isinstance(instruction, _AssertInstruction):
3653                matched_assertion = _assertion_matches(
3654                    instruction.kind, position, text, endpos
3655                )
3656                if not matched_assertion:
3657                    _record_explanation(
3658                        trace,
3659                        f"Assertion {instruction.kind.replace('_', ' ')} failed at position {position}.",
3660                    )
3661                if matched_assertion:
3662                    push(
3663                        instruction.target,
3664                        match_start,
3665                        captures,
3666                        lastindex,
3667                        repeat_starts,
3668                        empty_guards,
3669                        priority,
3670                    )
3671            elif isinstance(instruction, _LookInstruction):
3672                cached_result: bool | None = None
3673                cache_key = (id(instruction.program), instruction.entry)
3674                if (
3675                    instruction.kind == "ahead"
3676                    and not any(
3677                        isinstance(
3678                            child,
3679                            (_SaveInstruction, _LookInstruction, _BackrefInstruction),
3680                        )
3681                        for child in instruction.program
3682                    )
3683                ):
3684                    outcomes = look_cache.get(cache_key)
3685                    if outcomes is None:
3686                        outcomes = self._lookahead_results(
3687                            instruction.program, instruction.entry, text, endpos
3688                        )
3689                        look_cache[cache_key] = outcomes
3690                    cached_result = outcomes[position]
3691
3692                matched: Match | None = None
3693                if cached_result is None:
3694                    assertion_starts = (position,)
3695                    if instruction.kind == "behind":
3696                        if instruction.width is None:
3697                            raise RuntimeError("Lookbehind width bounds were not compiled")
3698                        minimum_width, maximum_width = instruction.width
3699                        earliest_start = (
3700                            0
3701                            if maximum_width is None
3702                            else max(0, position - maximum_width)
3703                        )
3704                        latest_start = position - minimum_width
3705                        assertion_starts = (
3706                            range(earliest_start, latest_start + 1)
3707                            if earliest_start <= latest_start
3708                            else ()
3709                        )
3710                    for assertion_start in assertion_starts:
3711                        matched = self._run_nfa(
3712                            text,
3713                            assertion_start,
3714                            search=False,
3715                            fullmatch=False,
3716                            program=instruction.program,
3717                            entry=instruction.entry,
3718                            initial_captures=captures,
3719                            initial_lastindex=lastindex,
3720                            end_position=(
3721                                position if instruction.kind == "behind" else None
3722                            ),
3723                            search_end=endpos,
3724                            match_pos=match_start,
3725                            match_string=match_string,
3726                            look_cache=look_cache,
3727                            trace=trace,
3728                        )
3729                        if matched is not None:
3730                            break
3731                    success = matched is not None
3732                else:
3733                    success = cached_result
