3734
3735                if trace is not None:
3736                    _record_explanation(
3737                        trace,
3738                        f"{'Look' if instruction.positive else 'Negative look'}"
3739                        f"{instruction.kind} "
3740                        f"{'succeeded' if success else 'failed'} at position {position}.",
3741                    )
3742                if instruction.positive and success:
3743                    push(
3744                        instruction.target,
3745                        match_start,
3746                        matched.captures if matched is not None else captures,
3747                        matched.lastindex if matched is not None else lastindex,
3748                        repeat_starts,
3749                        empty_guards,
3750                        priority,
3751                    )
3752                elif not instruction.positive and not success:
3753                    push(
3754                        instruction.target,
3755                        match_start,
3756                        captures,
3757                        lastindex,
3758                        repeat_starts,
3759                        empty_guards,
3760                        priority,
3761                    )
3762            elif isinstance(instruction, _GroupConditionInstruction):
3763                capture = captures[instruction.group - 1]
3764                matched_group = capture is not None and capture[1] >= 0
3765                if trace is not None:
3766                    _record_explanation(
3767                        trace,
3768                        f"Conditional group {instruction.group} is "
3769                        f"{'set' if matched_group else 'unset'} at position {position}.",
3770                    )
3771                target = (
3772                    instruction.yes
3773                    if matched_group
3774                    else instruction.no
3775                )
3776                push(
3777                    target,
3778                    match_start,
3779                    captures,
3780                    lastindex,
3781                    repeat_starts,
3782                    empty_guards,
3783                    priority,
3784                )
3785        return ordered
3786
3787    @staticmethod
3788    def _lookahead_results(
3789        instructions: tuple[_Instruction, ...], entry: int, text: str, endpos: int
3790    ) -> tuple[bool, ...]:
3791        reverse_epsilon: list[list[int]] = [
3792            [] for _ in range(len(instructions))
3793        ]
3794        for pc, instruction in enumerate(instructions):
3795            if isinstance(instruction, _SplitInstruction):
3796                targets = instruction.branches
3797            elif isinstance(
3798                instruction, (_AssertInstruction, _RepeatStartInstruction, _RepeatEndInstruction)
3799            ):
3800                targets = (instruction.target,)
3801            else:
3802                targets = ()
3803            for target in targets:
3804                reverse_epsilon[target].append(pc)
3805
3806        outcomes = [False] * (endpos + 1)
3807        next_reachable: set[int] = set()
3808        for position in range(endpos, -1, -1):
3809            reachable: set[int] = set()
3810            pending: list[int] = []
3811            for pc, instruction in enumerate(instructions):
3812                if isinstance(instruction, _MatchInstruction):
3813                    reachable.add(pc)
3814                    pending.append(pc)
3815                elif (
3816                    isinstance(instruction, _CharInstruction)
3817                    and position < endpos
3818                    and instruction.predicate(text[position])
3819                    and instruction.target in next_reachable
3820                ):
3821                    reachable.add(pc)
3822                    pending.append(pc)
3823
3824            while pending:
3825                target = pending.pop()
3826                for pc in reverse_epsilon[target]:
3827                    instruction = instructions[pc]
3828                    if (
3829                        isinstance(instruction, _AssertInstruction)
3830                        and not _assertion_matches(
3831                            instruction.kind, position, text, endpos
3832                        )
3833                    ):
3834                        continue
3835                    if pc not in reachable:
3836                        reachable.add(pc)
3837                        pending.append(pc)
3838
3839            outcomes[position] = entry in reachable
3840            next_reachable = reachable
3841        return tuple(outcomes)
3842
3843    def _compile(self, node: object) -> _Fragment:
3844        if isinstance(node, (_Empty, _GlobalFlags)):
3845            start, end = self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3846            self._states[start].epsilon.append(("epsilon", end, None))
3847            return _Fragment(start, end)
3848
3849        if isinstance(node, _Character):
3850            start, end = self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3851            self._states[start].transitions.append((node.predicate, node.label, end))
3852            return _Fragment(start, end)
3853
3854        if isinstance(node, _Assertion):
3855            start, end = self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3856            self._states[start].assertions.append((node.kind, end))
3857            return _Fragment(start, end)
3858
3859        if isinstance(node, _Lookaround):
3860            start, end = self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3861            label = f"lookaround:{len(self._dfa_lookarounds)}"
3862            self._dfa_lookarounds[label] = node
3863            self._states[start].assertions.append((label, end))
3864            return _Fragment(start, end)
3865
3866        if isinstance(node, _Backreference):
3867            start, end = self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3868            self._states[start].backreferences.append((node.group, end))
3869            return _Fragment(start, end)
3870
3871        if isinstance(node, _Group):
3872            fragment = self._compile(node.node)
3873            start, end = self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3874            self._states[start].epsilon.append(("save_start", fragment.start, node.index))
3875            self._states[fragment.end].epsilon.append(("save_end", end, node.index))
3876            return _Fragment(start, end)
3877
3878        if isinstance(node, _Atomic):
3879            return self._compile(node.node)
3880
3881        if isinstance(node, _Conditional):
3882            return self._compile(_Alternative((node.yes, node.no)))
3883
3884        if isinstance(node, _Sequence):
3885            fragments = [self._compile(item) for item in node.items]
3886            for left, right in zip(fragments, fragments[1:]):
3887                self._states[left.end].epsilon.append(("epsilon", right.start, None))
3888            return _Fragment(fragments[0].start, fragments[-1].end)
3889
3890        if isinstance(node, _Alternative):
3891            start, end = self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3892            for option in node.options:
3893                fragment = self._compile(option)
3894                self._states[start].epsilon.append(("epsilon", fragment.start, None))
3895                self._states[fragment.end].epsilon.append(("epsilon", end, None))
3896            return _Fragment(start, end)
3897
3898        if isinstance(node, _Repeat):
3899            return self._compile_repeat(node)
3900
3901        raise TypeError(f"Unsupported syntax node: {type(node).__name__}")
3902
3903    def _compile_repeat(self, node: _Repeat) -> _Fragment:
3904        if node.maximum is None and node.minimum == 1:
3905            body = self._compile(node.node)
3906            start, end, split = self._new_state(), self._new_state(), self._new_state()
3907            self._states[start].epsilon.append(("epsilon", body.start, None))
3908            choices = (
3909                [("epsilon", body.start, None), ("epsilon", end, None)]
3910                if node.greedy
3911                else [("epsilon", end, None), ("epsilon", body.start, None)]
3912            )
3913            self._states[split].epsilon.extend(choices)
3914            self._states[body.end].epsilon.append(("epsilon", split, None))
3915            return _Fragment(start, end)
3916
3917        fragments = [self._compile(node.node) for _ in range(node.minimum)]
3918        start = self._new_state()
3919        cursor = start
3920        for fragment in fragments:
3921            self._states[cursor].epsilon.append(("epsilon", fragment.start, None))
3922            cursor = fragment.end
3923
3924        end = self._new_state()
3925        if node.maximum is None:
3926            split = self._new_state()
3927            body = self._compile(node.node)
3928            choices = (
3929                [("epsilon", body.start, None), ("epsilon", end, None)]
3930                if node.greedy
3931                else [("epsilon", end, None), ("epsilon", body.start, None)]
3932            )
3933            self._states[split].epsilon.extend(choices)
3934            self._states[body.end].epsilon.append(("epsilon", split, None))
3935            self._states[cursor].epsilon.append(("epsilon", split, None))
3936            return _Fragment(start, end)
3937
3938        optional_count = node.maximum - node.minimum
3939        for index in range(optional_count):
3940            split = self._new_state()
3941            next_cursor = end if index == optional_count - 1 else self._new_state()
3942            body = self._compile(node.node)
3943            choices = (
3944                [("epsilon", body.start, None), ("epsilon", end, None)]
3945                if node.greedy
3946                else [("epsilon", end, None), ("epsilon", body.start, None)]
3947            )
3948            self._states[cursor].epsilon.append(("epsilon", split, None))
3949            self._states[split].epsilon.extend(choices)
3950            self._states[body.end].epsilon.append(("epsilon", next_cursor, None))
3951            cursor = next_cursor
3952        if optional_count == 0:
3953            self._states[cursor].epsilon.append(("epsilon", end, None))
3954        return _Fragment(start, end)
3955
3956    def _new_state(self) -> int:
3957        if len(self._states) >= self.limits.nfa_states:
3958            raise RegexComplexityError(
3959                f"Compiled patterns are limited to {self.limits.nfa_states} NFA states"
3960            )
3961        self._states.append(_State())
3962        return len(self._states) - 1
3963
3964    def _compile_vm(self) -> tuple[int, list[_Instruction]]:
3965        instruction_count = 0
3966        repeat_count = 0
3967
3968        def compile_program(root: object) -> tuple[int, list[_Instruction]]:
3969            nonlocal instruction_count
3970            instruction_count += 1
3971            if instruction_count > self.limits.nfa_states:
3972                raise RegexComplexityError(
3973                    f"Compiled patterns are limited to {self.limits.nfa_states} matcher instructions"
3974                )
3975            instructions: list[_Instruction] = [_MatchInstruction()]
3976
3977            def emit(instruction: _Instruction) -> int:
3978                nonlocal instruction_count
3979                instruction_count += 1
3980                if instruction_count > self.limits.nfa_states:
3981                    raise RegexComplexityError(
3982                        f"Compiled patterns are limited to {self.limits.nfa_states} matcher instructions"
3983                    )
3984                instructions.append(instruction)
3985                return len(instructions) - 1
3986
3987            def build(node: object, continuation: int) -> int:
3988                nonlocal repeat_count
3989                if isinstance(node, (_Empty, _GlobalFlags)):
3990                    return continuation
3991                if isinstance(node, _Character):
3992                    return emit(_CharInstruction(node.predicate, continuation))
3993                if isinstance(node, _Assertion):
3994                    return emit(_AssertInstruction(node.kind, continuation))
3995                if isinstance(node, _Lookaround):
3996                    entry, program = compile_program(node.node)
3997                    return emit(
3998                        _LookInstruction(
3999                            node.kind,
4000                            node.positive,
4001                            entry,
4002                            tuple(program),
4003                            _width_bounds(node.node) if node.kind == "behind" else None,
4004                            continuation,
4005                        )
4006                    )
4007                if isinstance(node, _Atomic):
4008                    group = self._atomic_group_indices[id(node)]
4009                    backreference = emit(_BackrefInstruction(group, continuation))
4010                    entry, program = compile_program(_Group(group, node.node))
4011                    return emit(
4012                        _LookInstruction(
4013                            "ahead", True, entry, tuple(program), None, backreference
4014                        )
4015                    )
4016                if isinstance(node, _Conditional):
4017                    if not isinstance(node.group, int):
4018                        raise RuntimeError("Conditional group reference was not resolved")
4019                    yes = build(node.yes, continuation)
4020                    no = build(node.no, continuation)
4021                    return emit(_GroupConditionInstruction(node.group, yes, no))
4022                if isinstance(node, _Backreference):
4023                    return emit(_BackrefInstruction(node.group, continuation))
4024                if isinstance(node, _Group):
4025                    after = emit(_SaveInstruction(node.index, continuation, False))
4026                    body = build(node.node, after)
4027                    return emit(_SaveInstruction(node.index, body, True))
4028                if isinstance(node, _Sequence):
4029                    current = continuation
4030                    for item in reversed(node.items):
4031                        current = build(item, current)
4032                    return current
4033                if isinstance(node, _Alternative):
4034                    branches = tuple(build(option, continuation) for option in node.options)
4035                    return emit(_SplitInstruction(branches))
4036                if isinstance(node, _Repeat):
4037                    current = continuation
4038                    if node.maximum is None:
4039                        repeat_id = repeat_count
4040                        repeat_count += 1
4041                        split = emit(_SplitInstruction(()))
4042                        repeat_end = emit(_RepeatEndInstruction(repeat_id, split))
4043                        body = build(node.node, repeat_end)
4044                        repeat_start = emit(
4045                            _RepeatStartInstruction(repeat_id, body)
4046                        )
4047                        choices = (
4048                            (repeat_start, current)
4049                            if node.greedy
4050                            else (current, repeat_start)
4051                        )
4052                        instruction = instructions[split]
4053                        if not isinstance(instruction, _SplitInstruction):
4054                            raise RuntimeError("Expected a split instruction")
4055                        instruction.branches = choices
4056                        instruction.repeat_id = repeat_id
4057                        instruction.body_branch = 0 if node.greedy else 1
4058                        instruction.unbounded_repeat = True
4059                        current = split if node.minimum == 0 else repeat_start
4060                        for _ in range(node.minimum - 1):
4061                            current = build(node.node, current)
4062                        return current
4063                    else:
4064                        optional_count = node.maximum - node.minimum
4065                        repeat_id = repeat_count if optional_count else None
4066                        if repeat_id is not None:
4067                            repeat_count += 1
4068                        for _ in range(node.maximum - node.minimum):
4069                            body_continuation = current
4070                            if repeat_id is not None:
4071                                body_continuation = emit(
4072                                    _RepeatEndInstruction(repeat_id, current)
4073                                )
4074                            body = build(node.node, body_continuation)
4075                            if repeat_id is not None:
4076                                body = emit(_RepeatStartInstruction(repeat_id, body))
4077                            branches = (
4078                                (body, continuation)
4079                                if node.greedy
4080                                else (continuation, body)
4081                            )
4082                            current = emit(
4083                                _SplitInstruction(
4084                                    branches,
4085                                    repeat_id,
4086                                    0 if node.greedy else 1,
4087                                )
4088                            )
4089                    for _ in range(node.minimum):
4090                        current = build(node.node, current)
4091                    return current
4092                raise TypeError(f"Unsupported syntax node: {type(node).__name__}")
4093
4094            return build(root, 0), instructions
4095
4096        return compile_program(self._syntax)
4097
4098    def _run_vm(
4099        self,
4100        text: str,
4101        start: int,
4102        fullmatch: bool,
4103        budget: list[int],
4104        *,
4105        program: tuple[_Instruction, ...] | None = None,
4106        entry: int | None = None,
4107        initial_captures: tuple[tuple[int, int] | None, ...] | None = None,
4108        initial_lastindex: int | None = None,
4109        end_position: int | None = None,
4110        search_end: int | None = None,
4111        match_pos: int | None = None,
4112        match_string: str | bytes | None = None,
4113        reject_empty: bool = False,
4114        trace: list[str] | None = None,
4115    ) -> Match | None:
4116        if self._vm is None:
4117            raise RuntimeError("Backreference VM was not compiled")
4118        instructions = program if program is not None else tuple(self._vm)
4119        start_pc = entry if entry is not None else self._vm_entry
4120        limit = len(text) if search_end is None else search_end
4121        match_start_pos = start if match_pos is None else match_pos
4122        captures = initial_captures or (None,) * self._capture_count
4123        stack: list[
4124            tuple[
4125                int,
4126                int,
4127                tuple[tuple[int, int] | None, ...],
4128                int | None,
4129                dict[int, int],
4130                dict[int, int],
4131                set[tuple[int, int, tuple[tuple[int, int] | None, ...]]],
4132            ]
4133        ] = [(start_pc, start, captures, initial_lastindex, {}, {}, set())]
4134
4135        while stack:
4136            (
4137                pc,
4138                position,
4139                current_captures,
4140                lastindex,
4141                repeat_starts,
4142                capture_starts,
4143                visited,
4144            ) = stack.pop()
4145            while True:
4146                budget[0] += 1
4147                if budget[0] > self.limits.backtrack_steps:
4148                    if trace is not None:
4149                        _record_explanation(
4150                            trace,
4151                            f"The backtracking step limit ({self.limits.backtrack_steps}) was reached.",
4152                        )
4153                    raise RegexMatchLimitError(
4154                        f"Backtracking matching exceeded {self.limits.backtrack_steps} steps"
4155                    )
4156                configuration = (pc, position, current_captures)
4157                if configuration in visited:
4158                    instruction = instructions[pc]
4159                    if not (
4160                        isinstance(instruction, _SplitInstruction)
4161                        and instruction.unbounded_repeat
4162                        and instruction.repeat_id is not None
4163                        and repeat_starts.get(instruction.repeat_id) == position
4164                    ):
4165                        break
4166                else:
4167                    visited.add(configuration)
4168                instruction = instructions[pc]
4169                if isinstance(instruction, _MatchInstruction):
4170                    if (
4171                        (not fullmatch or position == limit)
4172                        and (end_position is None or position == end_position)
4173                    ):
4174                        if reject_empty and position == start:
4175                            if trace is not None:
4176                                _record_explanation(
4177                                    trace,
4178                                    f"Empty match at position {position} was rejected to advance iteration.",
4179                                )
4180                            break
4181                        if trace is not None:
4182                            _record_explanation(
4183                                trace,
4184                                f"Accepting path found from candidate start {start} through {position}.",
4185                            )
4186                        return self._make_match(
4187                            text,
4188                            start,
4189                            position,
4190                            current_captures,
4191                            lastindex,
4192                            match_start_pos,
4193                            limit,
4194                            match_string,
4195                        )
4196                    if trace is not None:
4197                        _record_explanation(
4198                            trace,
4199                            f"Pattern ended at position {position}, but the required end condition failed.",
4200                        )
4201                    break
4202                elif isinstance(instruction, _CharInstruction):
4203                    if (
4204                        position >= limit
4205                        or not instruction.predicate(text[position])
4206                    ):
4207                        if trace is not None:
4208                            _record_explanation(
4209                                trace,
4210                                f"Character condition failed at position {position}"
4211                                + (
4212                                    " because the search bounds ended."
4213                                    if position >= limit
4214                                    else f" for input {text[position]!r}."
4215                                ),
4216                            )
4217                        break
4218                    position += 1
4219                    pc = instruction.target
4220                elif isinstance(instruction, _AssertInstruction):
4221                    if not _assertion_matches(
4222                        instruction.kind, position, text, limit
4223                    ):
4224                        if trace is not None:
4225                            _record_explanation(
4226                                trace,
4227                                f"Assertion {instruction.kind.replace('_', ' ')} failed at position {position}.",
4228                            )
4229                        break
4230                    pc = instruction.target
4231                elif isinstance(instruction, _BackrefInstruction):
4232                    span = current_captures[instruction.group - 1]
4233                    if span is None or span[1] < 0:
4234                        if trace is not None:
4235                            _record_explanation(
4236                                trace,
4237                                f"Backreference group {instruction.group} is unset at position {position}.",
4238                            )
4239                        break
4240                    value = text[span[0] : span[1]]
4241                    candidate = text[position : position + len(value)]
4242                    if position + len(value) > limit or (
4243                        not all(
4244                            _case_insensitive_equal(
4245                                left,
4246                                right,
4247                                bool(self.flags & ASCII),
4248                                bool(self.flags & LOCALE),
4249                            )
4250                            for left, right in zip(value, candidate)
4251                        )
4252                        if self.flags & IGNORECASE
4253                        else value != candidate
4254                    ):
4255                        if trace is not None:
4256                            _record_explanation(
4257                                trace,
4258                                f"Backreference group {instruction.group} did not match at position {position}.",
4259                            )
4260                        break
4261                    position += len(value)
4262                    pc = instruction.target
4263                elif isinstance(instruction, _SaveInstruction):
4264                    if instruction.is_start:
4265                        capture_starts = capture_starts.copy()
4266                        capture_starts[instruction.group] = position
4267                    else:
4268                        updated = list(current_captures)
4269                        capture_start = capture_starts.get(
4270                            instruction.group, position
4271                        )
4272                        updated[instruction.group - 1] = (
4273                            capture_start,
4274                            position,
4275                        )
4276                        current_captures = tuple(updated)
4277                        capture_starts = capture_starts.copy()
4278                        capture_starts.pop(instruction.group, None)
4279                        if instruction.group <= self.groups:
4280                            lastindex = instruction.group
4281                    pc = instruction.target
4282                elif isinstance(
4283                    instruction, (_RepeatStartInstruction, _RepeatEndInstruction)
4284                ):
4285                    if isinstance(instruction, _RepeatStartInstruction):
4286                        repeat_starts[instruction.repeat_id] = position
4287                        visited.clear()
4288                    pc = instruction.target
4289                elif isinstance(instruction, _SplitInstruction):
4290                    branches = instruction.branches
4291
4292                    if len(branches) == 0:
4293                        raise RuntimeError("Split instruction has no branches")
4294
4295                    if (
4296                        instruction.unbounded_repeat
4297                        and instruction.repeat_id in repeat_starts
4298                        and repeat_starts[instruction.repeat_id] == position
4299                    ):
4300                        if instruction.body_branch is None:
4301                            raise RuntimeError("Unbounded repeat has no body branch")
4302
4303                        if trace is not None:
4304                            _record_explanation(
4305                                trace,
4306                                f"Repeat stopped at position {position} after an empty iteration.",
4307                            )
4308
4309                        pc = branches[1 - instruction.body_branch]
4310                        continue
4311
4312                    if trace is not None and len(branches) > 1:
4313                        _record_explanation(
4314                            trace,
4315                            f"Trying {len(branches)} prioritized alternative(s) at position {position}.",
4316                        )
4317
4318                    for branch in reversed(branches[1:]):
4319                        stack.append(
4320                            (
4321                                branch,
4322                                position,
4323                                current_captures,
4324                                lastindex,
4325                                repeat_starts.copy(),
4326                                capture_starts.copy(),
4327                                visited.copy(),
4328                            )
4329                        )
4330
4331                    pc = branches[0]
4332                elif isinstance(instruction, _LookInstruction):
4333                    matched = None
4334                    if instruction.kind == "behind":
4335                        if instruction.width is None:
4336                            raise RuntimeError("Lookbehind width bounds were not compiled")
4337                        minimum_width, maximum_width = instruction.width
4338                        earliest_start = (
4339                            0
4340                            if maximum_width is None
4341                            else max(0, position - maximum_width)
4342                        )
4343                        latest_start = position - minimum_width
4344                        assertion_starts = (
4345                            range(earliest_start, latest_start + 1)
4346                            if earliest_start <= latest_start
4347                            else ()
4348                        )
4349                        for assertion_start in assertion_starts:
4350                            matched = self._run_vm(
4351                                text,
4352                                assertion_start,
4353                                False,
4354                                budget,
4355                                program=instruction.program,
4356                                entry=instruction.entry,
4357                                initial_captures=current_captures,
4358                                initial_lastindex=lastindex,
4359                                end_position=position,
4360                                search_end=limit,
4361                                match_pos=match_start_pos,
4362                                match_string=match_string,
4363                                trace=trace,
4364                            )
4365                            if matched is not None:
4366                                break
4367                    else:
4368                        matched = self._run_vm(
4369                            text,
4370                            position,
4371                            False,
4372                            budget,
4373                            program=instruction.program,
4374                            entry=instruction.entry,
4375                            initial_captures=current_captures,
4376                            initial_lastindex=lastindex,
4377                            search_end=limit,
4378                            match_pos=match_start_pos,
4379                            match_string=match_string,
4380                            trace=trace,
4381                        )
4382                    success = matched is not None
4383                    if trace is not None:
4384                        _record_explanation(
4385                            trace,
4386                            f"{'Look' if instruction.positive else 'Negative look'}"
4387                            f"{instruction.kind} "
4388                            f"{'succeeded' if success else 'failed'} at position {position}.",
4389                        )
4390                    if success != instruction.positive:
4391                        break
4392                    if instruction.positive and matched is not None:
4393                        current_captures = matched.captures
4394                        lastindex = matched.lastindex
4395                    pc = instruction.target
4396                elif isinstance(instruction, _GroupConditionInstruction):
4397                    capture = current_captures[instruction.group - 1]
4398                    matched_group = capture is not None and capture[1] >= 0
4399                    if trace is not None:
4400                        _record_explanation(
4401                            trace,
4402                            f"Conditional group {instruction.group} is "
4403                            f"{'set' if matched_group else 'unset'} "
4404                            f"at position {position}.",
4405                        )
4406                    pc = (
4407                        instruction.yes
4408                        if matched_group
4409                        else instruction.no
4410                    )
4411                else:
4412                    raise RuntimeError(f"Unknown matcher instruction: {instruction!r}")
4413        return None
4414
4415    def to_dot(self) -> str:
4416        """Export the compiled NFA as a Graphviz DOT description.
4417
4418        The generated graph represents the compiled states and their
4419        connections, including epsilon transitions, assertions,
4420        consuming transitions, and backreferences.
4421
4422        The DOT output can be rendered using Graphviz-compatible tools
4423        to help inspect the compiled pattern structure.
4424
4425        Returns:
4426            A string containing the Graphviz DOT representation.
4427        """
4428        lines = ["digraph NFA {", "  rankdir=LR;", '  node [shape=circle];']
4429        lines.append(f'  start [shape=point]; start -> {self._start};')
4430        for state_id, state in enumerate(self._states):
4431            shape = "doublecircle" if state_id == self._accept else "circle"
4432            lines.append(f'  {state_id} [shape={shape}, label="{state_id}"];')
4433            for kind, target, group in state.epsilon:
4434                label = f"save {group} start" if kind == "save_start" else (
4435                    f"save {group} end" if kind == "save_end" else "ε"
4436                )
4437                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(label)}];")
4438            for kind, target in state.assertions:
4439                label = {
4440                    "start": "^",
4441                    "end": "$",
4442                    "absolute_start": r"\A",
4443                    "absolute_end": r"\Z",
4444                    "word_boundary": r"\b",
4445                    "not_word_boundary": r"\B",
4446                }.get(kind, kind.replace("_", " "))
4447                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(label)}];")
4448            for _, label, target in state.transitions:
4449                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(label)}];")
4450            for group, target in state.backreferences:
4451                lines.append(f'  {state_id} -> {target} [label="\\\\{group}"];')
4452        lines.append("}")
4453        return "\n".join(lines)
4454
4455    def to_dfa(self, alphabet: str) -> DFA:
4456        """Determinize this pattern over an explicit finite alphabet."""
4457        if not isinstance(alphabet, str):
4458            raise TypeError("alphabet must be a string")
4459        if self._has_backreferences:
4460            raise ValueError("Backreference patterns cannot be converted to a DFA")
4461        if self._has_conditionals:
4462            raise ValueError("Conditional groups cannot be converted to a DFA")
4463        return DFA.from_regex(self, alphabet)

Compile and execute regular expressions.

Regex objects represent compiled patterns and can be reused for searching, matching, finding multiple matches, and substitutions.

The engine uses an ordered Thompson NFA for supported patterns and a bounded backtracking virtual machine for features requiring backtracking.

Patterns may be strings or bytes. Matching behavior can be configured using flags and resource limits.

Args: pattern: Regular expression pattern to compile. flags: Optional compilation flags. limits: Optional resource limits controlling compilation and matching complexity.

Raises: TypeError: If the pattern, flags, or limits have invalid types. ValueError: If incompatible or unsupported flags are supplied. RegexSyntaxError: If the pattern contains invalid syntax. RegexComplexityError: If a configured complexity limit is exceeded.

Regex( pattern: str | bytes, flags: int = 0, limits: regex_engine.RegexLimits | None = None) 
2292    def __init__(
2293        self, pattern: str | bytes, flags: int = 0, limits: RegexLimits | None = None
2294    ):
2295        if not isinstance(pattern, (str, bytes)):
2296            raise TypeError("pattern must be a string or bytes")
2297        if not isinstance(flags, int):
2298            raise TypeError("flags must be an integer")
2299        supported_flags = (
2300            IGNORECASE
2301            | MULTILINE
2302            | DOTALL
2303            | VERBOSE
2304            | ASCII
2305            | UNICODE
2306            | DEBUG
2307            | LOCALE
2308        )
2309        if flags & ~supported_flags:
2310            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported regex flags: {flags & ~supported_flags!r}")
2311        self._bytes_mode = isinstance(pattern, bytes)
2312        if self._bytes_mode and flags & UNICODE:
2313            raise ValueError("Unicode matching is not supported for bytes patterns")
2314        if flags & LOCALE and not self._bytes_mode:
2315            raise ValueError("LOCALE flag is only supported for bytes patterns")
2316        if flags & LOCALE and flags & (ASCII | UNICODE):
2317            raise ValueError("LOCALE is incompatible with ASCII and UNICODE flags")
2318        if flags & ASCII and flags & UNICODE:
2319            raise ValueError("ASCII and UNICODE flags are incompatible")
2320        self.limits = limits or RegexLimits()
2321        if not isinstance(self.limits, RegexLimits):
2322            raise TypeError("limits must be a RegexLimits instance")
2323        if len(pattern) > self.limits.pattern_length:
2324            raise RegexComplexityError(
2325                f"Patterns are limited to {self.limits.pattern_length} characters"
2326            )
2327        self.pattern = pattern
2328        pattern_text = (
2329            pattern.decode("latin-1") if isinstance(pattern, bytes) else pattern
2330        )
2331        parser_flags = flags
2332        if self._bytes_mode and not flags & LOCALE:
2333            parser_flags |= ASCII
2334        elif not self._bytes_mode and not parser_flags & ASCII:
2335            parser_flags |= UNICODE
2336        parser = _Parser(pattern_text, parser_flags, self.limits, self._bytes_mode)
2337        try:
2338            self._syntax = parser.parse()
2339        except RegexSyntaxError as error:
2340            error.pattern = pattern
2341            raise
2342        self.flags = parser.compiled_flags
2343        if self._bytes_mode and not flags & ASCII:
2344            self.flags &= ~ASCII
2345        self.groups = parser.group_count
2346        self.groupindex = dict(parser.groupindex)
2347        atomic_nodes = _atomic_nodes(self._syntax)
2348        self._atomic_group_indices = {
2349            id(node): self.groups + index + 1
2350            for index, node in enumerate(atomic_nodes)
2351        }
2352        self._capture_count = self.groups + len(atomic_nodes)
2353        self._has_conditionals = _contains_conditional(self._syntax)
2354        self._has_lookarounds = _contains_lookaround(self._syntax)
2355        self._dfa_lookarounds: dict[str, _Lookaround] = {}
2356        self._simple_backreference_tail = self._find_simple_backreference_tail(
2357            self._syntax
2358        )
2359        self._literal = (
2360            _literal_text(self._syntax)
2361            if self.groups == 0
2362            and not parser.has_scoped_flags
2363            and not self.flags & IGNORECASE
2364            else None
2365        )
2366        self._required_literals = (
2367            set() if parser.has_scoped_flags else _guaranteed_literals(self._syntax)
2368        )
2369        self._has_backreferences = bool(parser.backreferences)
2370        self._requires_vm = (
2371            self._has_backreferences
2372            or bool(atomic_nodes)
2373            or self._has_conditionals
2374            or _contains_variable_width_lookbehind(self._syntax)
2375            or _contains_nullable_alternative_repeat(self._syntax)
2376        )
2377        self._states: list[_State] = []
2378        fragment = self._compile(self._syntax)
2379        self._start = fragment.start
2380        self._accept = fragment.end
2381        self._first_char_predicate = _first_character_predicate(self._syntax)
2382        self._first_char_literals = (
2383            None
2384            if parser.has_scoped_flags
2385            or self.flags & LOCALE
2386            or _nullable(self._syntax)
2387            else _first_character_literals(self._syntax)
2388        )
2389        self._lazy_dfa_enabled = (
2390            self.groups == 0
2391            and not self._has_backreferences
2392            and not self._requires_vm
2393            and not any(state.assertions for state in self._states)
2394        )
2395        self._lazy_dfa_lock = RLock()
2396        self._lazy_dfa_subsets: list[frozenset[int]] = []
2397        self._lazy_dfa_indices: dict[frozenset[int], int] = {}
2398        self._lazy_dfa_transitions: dict[tuple[int, str], int] = {}
2399        self._lazy_dfa_characters: set[str] = set()
2400        if self._lazy_dfa_enabled:
2401            initial = self._lazy_dfa_closure({self._start})
2402            self._lazy_dfa_subsets.append(initial)
2403            self._lazy_dfa_indices[initial] = 0
2404        self._vm: list[_Instruction] | None = None
2405        self._vm_entry = 0
2406        if self._literal is None or self._requires_vm:
2407            self._vm_entry, self._vm = self._compile_vm()
2408        self._preserve_repeat_history = self._capture_count > 0 or (
2409            self._vm is not None
2410            and any(isinstance(item, _AssertInstruction) for item in self._vm)
2411            and any(
2412                isinstance(item, _SplitInstruction)
2413                and item.repeat_id is not None
2414                and item.body_branch == 1
2415                for item in self._vm
2416            )
2417        )
2418        if flags & DEBUG:
2419            print(self.to_dot())

def explain(self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> str: 
2597    def explain(
2598        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2599    ) -> str:
2600        """Explain how the engine processes a search operation.
2601
2602        Provides a textual trace describing the selected matching
2603        engine, search bounds, candidate positions, and matching
2604        decisions.
2605
2606        This is intended for debugging and understanding why a
2607        pattern matched or failed to match.
2608
2609        Args:
2610            text: String or bytes input to search.
2611            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
2612            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
2613
2614        Returns:
2615            A textual explanation of the search process.
2616
2617        Raises:
2618            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
2619        """
2620        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
2621        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
2622        events = [
2623            f"Pattern: {self.pattern!r}",
2624            f"Input length: {len(text)}",
2625            f"Search bounds: [{pos}, {limit})",
2626            "Matcher: "
2627            + (
2628                "backtracking VM"
2629                if self._requires_vm
2630                else "ordered Thompson NFA"
2631                if self._literal is None
2632                else "literal search"
2633            ),
2634        ]
2635        match = self._search_from(
2636            text,
2637            pos,
2638            endpos=limit,
2639            match_string=match_string,
2640            trace=events,
2641        )
2642        if match is None:
2643            events.append("Result: no match.")
2644        else:
2645            events.append(f"Result: matched span {match.span()}.")
2646            for name, value in match.groupdict().items():
2647                events.append(f"  Group {name!r}: {value!r}")
2648            if self.groups:
2649                for index, value in enumerate(match.groups(), 1):
2650                    events.append(f"  Group {index}: {value!r}")
2651        return "\n".join(events)

2851    def match(
2852        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2853    ) -> Match | None:
2854        """Match the pattern at the specified starting position.
2855
2856        Unlike search(), this method only attempts a match at ``pos``.
2857        It does not scan later positions in the input.
2858
2859        Args:
2860            text: String or bytes input to match against.
2861            pos: Position at which matching begins. Defaults to 0.
2862            endpos: Optional ending position of the matching region.
2863
2864        Returns:
2865            A Match object if the pattern matches at ``pos``,
2866            or None otherwise.
2867
2868        Raises:
2869            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
2870        """
2871        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
2872        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
2873        if pos > limit:
2874            return None
2875        if not self._required_text_is_present(text, pos, limit):
2876            return None
2877        if self._literal is not None:
2878            if not text.startswith(self._literal, pos, limit):
2879                return None
2880            return self._make_match(
2881                text,
2882                pos,
2883                pos + len(self._literal),
2884                pos=pos,
2885                endpos=limit,
2886                match_string=match_string,
2887            )
2888        if self._simple_backreference_tail is not None:
2889            return self._simple_backreference_match(
2890                text, pos, limit, pos, match_string, fullmatch=False
2891            )
2892        if self._requires_vm:
2893            return self._run_vm(
2894                text,
2895                pos,
2896                False,
2897                [0],
2898                search_end=limit,
2899                match_pos=pos,
2900                match_string=match_string,
2901            )
2902        return self._run_nfa(
2903            text,
2904            pos,
2905            search=False,
2906            fullmatch=False,
2907            search_end=limit,
2908            match_pos=pos,
2909            match_string=match_string,
2910        )

2912    def fullmatch(
2913        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2914    ) -> Match | None:
2915        """Check whether the entire specified input region matches.
2916
2917        The pattern must match from ``pos`` through ``endpos``.
2918        Unlike search(), this method does not accept a partial match.
2919
2920        Args:
2921            text: String or bytes input to match against.
2922            pos: Starting position of the matching region. Defaults to 0.
2923            endpos: Optional ending position of the matching region.
2924
2925        Returns:
2926            A Match object if the entire region matches, or None otherwise.
2927
2928        Raises:
2929            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
2930        """
2931        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
2932        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
2933        if pos > limit:
2934            return None
2935        if not self._required_text_is_present(text, pos, limit):
2936            return None
2937        if self._simple_backreference_tail is not None:
2938            return self._simple_backreference_match(
2939                text, pos, limit, pos, match_string, fullmatch=True
2940            )
2941        if self._lazy_dfa_enabled:
2942            matched = self._lazy_dfa_fullmatch(text, pos, limit)
2943            if matched is not None:
2944                return (
2945                    self._make_match(
2946                        text,
2947                        pos,
2948                        limit,
2949                        pos=pos,
2950                        endpos=limit,
2951                        match_string=match_string,
2952                    )
2953                    if matched
2954                    else None
2955                )
2956        if self._literal is not None:
2957            if text[pos:limit] != self._literal:
2958                return None
2959            return self._make_match(

2961            )
2962        if self._requires_vm:
2963            return self._run_vm(
2964                text,
2965                pos,
2966                True,
2967                [0],
2968                search_end=limit,
2969                match_pos=pos,
2970                match_string=match_string,
2971            )
2972        return self._run_nfa(
2973            text,
2974            pos,
2975            search=False,
2976            fullmatch=True,
2977            search_end=limit,
2978            match_pos=pos,
2979            match_string=match_string,

def finditer( self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> Iterator[regex_engine.Match]: 
2982    def finditer(
2983        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
2984    ) -> Iterator[Match]:
2985        """Return an iterator yielding Match objects for successive matches.
2986
2987        Matches are found from left to right within the specified input
2988        region. Empty matches are handled without repeatedly yielding
2989        the same empty match at one position.
2990
2991        Args:
2992            text: String or bytes input to search.
2993            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
2994            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
2995
2996        Returns:
2997            An iterator yielding Match objects.
2998
2999        Raises:
3000            TypeError: If the input type does not match the pattern type.
3001        """
3002        text, match_string = self._prepare_text(text)
3003        pos, limit = _normalize_bounds(text, pos, endpos)
3004        position = pos
3005        reject_empty_at: int | None = None
3006        while position <= limit:
3007            match = self._search_from(
3008                text,
3009                position,
3010                endpos=limit,
3011                reject_empty_at=reject_empty_at,
3012                match_string=match_string,
3013            )
3014            if match is None:
3015                return
3016            yield match
3017            if match.start() == match.end():
3018                position = match.end()
3019                reject_empty_at = match.end()
3020            else:
3021                position = match.end()
3022                reject_empty_at = None

def findall( self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> list[str | bytes] | list[tuple[str | bytes, ...]]: 
3024    def findall(
3025        self, text: str | bytes, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None
3026    ) -> list[str | bytes] | list[tuple[str | bytes, ...]]:
3027        """Return all non-overlapping matches as a list.
3028
3029        The returned values depend on the number of capturing groups:
3030        - No capturing groups: matched strings are returned.
3031        - One capturing group: the captured values are returned.
3032        - Multiple capturing groups: tuples of captured values are returned.
3033
3034        Unmatched optional groups are represented by an empty string
3035        or empty bytes value, depending on the pattern type.
3036
3037        Args:
3038            text: String or bytes input to search.
3039            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
3040            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
3041
3042        Returns:
3043            A list containing matched strings, bytes, or tuples of
3044            captured values.
3045        """
3046        empty = b"" if self._bytes_mode else ""
3047        if self.groups == 0:
3048            return [
3049                match.string[match.start() : match.end()]
3050                for match in self.finditer(text, pos, endpos)
3051            ]
3052        if self.groups == 1:
3053            return [
3054                value if value is not None else empty
3055                for match in self.finditer(text, pos, endpos)
3056                for value in match.groups()
3057            ]
3058        return [
3059            tuple(value if value is not None else empty for value in match.groups())
3060            for match in self.finditer(text, pos, endpos)
3061        ]

def subn( self, replacement: str | bytes | Callable[[regex_engine.Match], str | bytes], text: str | bytes, count: int = 0, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> tuple[str | bytes, int]: 
3063    def subn(
3064        self,
3065        replacement: str | bytes | Callable[[Match], str | bytes],
3066        text: str | bytes,
3067        count: int = 0,
3068        pos: int = 0,
3069        endpos: int | None = None,
3070    ) -> tuple[str | bytes, int]:
3071        """Replace matches and return the resulting input and replacement count.
3072
3073        The replacement can be a string, bytes value, or callable.
3074        A callable receives each Match object and must return a value
3075        of the same type as the input.
3076
3077        Replacement templates support capture-group references.
3078
3079        Args:
3080            replacement: Replacement template or callable.
3081            text: String or bytes input to process.
3082            count: Maximum number of replacements. Zero means unlimited.
3083            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
3084            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
3085
3086        Returns:
3087            A tuple containing the resulting input and the number
3088            of substitutions performed.
3089
3090        Raises:
3091            TypeError: If argument types are invalid or replacement
3092                results do not match the input type.
3093            ValueError: If count is negative.
3094        """
3095        _, source_text = self._prepare_text(text)
3096        if not isinstance(count, int):
3097            raise TypeError("count must be an integer")
3098        if count < 0:
3099            raise ValueError("count must be non-negative")
3100        if not isinstance(replacement, (str, bytes)) and not callable(replacement):
3101            raise TypeError("replacement must be a string, bytes, or callable")
3102        if self._bytes_mode != isinstance(replacement, bytes) and not callable(replacement):
3103            raise TypeError("replacement type must match the pattern type")
3104        template_parts = None
3105        if not callable(replacement):
3106            template = (
3107                replacement.decode("latin-1")
3108                if isinstance(replacement, bytes)
3109                else replacement
3110            )
3111            template_parts = _parse_template(template, self.groupindex, self.groups)
3112        pieces: list[str | bytes] = []
3113        cursor = 0
3114        substitutions = 0
3115        matches = iter(self.finditer(source_text, pos, endpos))
3116        while not count or substitutions < count:
3117            try:
3118                match = next(matches)
3119            except StopIteration:
3120                break
3121            pieces.append(source_text[cursor : match.start()])
3122            if callable(replacement):
3123                value = replacement(match)
3124            else:
3125                if template_parts is None:
3126                    raise RuntimeError("Replacement template was not parsed")
3127                expanded = _render_template(template_parts, match)
3128                value = (
3129                    expanded.encode("latin-1")
3130                    if isinstance(replacement, bytes)
3131                    else expanded
3132                )
3133            if not isinstance(value, type(source_text)):
3134                raise TypeError("replacement function must return the same type as the input")
3135            pieces.append(value)
3136            cursor = match.end()
3137            substitutions += 1
3138        pieces.append(source_text[cursor:])
3139        if isinstance(source_text, bytes):
3140            byte_pieces = [piece for piece in pieces if isinstance(piece, bytes)]
3141            if len(byte_pieces) != len(pieces):
3142                raise RuntimeError("Bytes substitution produced a non-bytes piece")
3143            return b"".join(byte_pieces), substitutions
3144        string_pieces = [piece for piece in pieces if isinstance(piece, str)]
3145        if len(string_pieces) != len(pieces):
3146            raise RuntimeError("String substitution produced a non-string piece")
3147        return "".join(string_pieces), substitutions

def split( self, text: str | bytes, maxsplit: int = 0, pos: int = 0, endpos: int | None = None) -> list[str | bytes | None]: 
3174    def split(
3175        self,
3176        text: str | bytes,
3177        maxsplit: int = 0,
3178        pos: int = 0,
3179        endpos: int | None = None,
3180    ) -> list[str | bytes | None]:
3181        """Split the input using occurrences of the compiled pattern.
3182
3183        Capturing groups in the pattern are included in the resulting
3184        list. Unmatched optional capturing groups may produce None.
3185
3186        Args:
3187            text: String or bytes input to split.
3188            maxsplit: Maximum number of splits. Zero means unlimited.
3189            pos: Starting position of the search. Defaults to 0.
3190            endpos: Optional ending position of the search.
3191
3192        Returns:
3193            A list containing the resulting string or bytes segments
3194            and captured separator values.
3195        """
3196        _, source_text = self._prepare_text(text)
3197        if not isinstance(maxsplit, int):
3198            raise TypeError("maxsplit must be an integer")
3199        if maxsplit < 0:
3200            raise ValueError("maxsplit must be non-negative")
3201        pieces: list[str | bytes | None] = []
3202        cursor = 0
3203        splits = 0
3204        matches = iter(self.finditer(source_text, pos, endpos))
3205        while not maxsplit or splits < maxsplit:
3206            try:
3207                match = next(matches)
3208            except StopIteration:
3209                break
3210            pieces.append(source_text[cursor : match.start()])
3211            if self.groups:
3212                pieces.extend(match.groups())
3213            cursor = match.end()
3214            splits += 1
3215        pieces.append(source_text[cursor:])
3216        return pieces

def to_dot(self) -> str: 
4415    def to_dot(self) -> str:
4416        """Export the compiled NFA as a Graphviz DOT description.
4417
4418        The generated graph represents the compiled states and their
4419        connections, including epsilon transitions, assertions,
4420        consuming transitions, and backreferences.
4421
4422        The DOT output can be rendered using Graphviz-compatible tools
4423        to help inspect the compiled pattern structure.
4424
4425        Returns:
4426            A string containing the Graphviz DOT representation.
4427        """
4428        lines = ["digraph NFA {", "  rankdir=LR;", '  node [shape=circle];']
4429        lines.append(f'  start [shape=point]; start -> {self._start};')
4430        for state_id, state in enumerate(self._states):
4431            shape = "doublecircle" if state_id == self._accept else "circle"
4432            lines.append(f'  {state_id} [shape={shape}, label="{state_id}"];')
4433            for kind, target, group in state.epsilon:
4434                label = f"save {group} start" if kind == "save_start" else (
4435                    f"save {group} end" if kind == "save_end" else "ε"
4436                )
4437                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(label)}];")
4438            for kind, target in state.assertions:
4439                label = {
4440                    "start": "^",
4441                    "end": "$",
4442                    "absolute_start": r"\A",
4443                    "absolute_end": r"\Z",
4444                    "word_boundary": r"\b",
4445                    "not_word_boundary": r"\B",
4446                }.get(kind, kind.replace("_", " "))
4447                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(label)}];")
4448            for _, label, target in state.transitions:
4449                lines.append(f"  {state_id} -> {target} [label={_dot_quote(label)}];")
4450            for group, target in state.backreferences:
4451                lines.append(f'  {state_id} -> {target} [label="\\\\{group}"];')
4452        lines.append("}")
4453        return "\n".join(lines)

The DOT output can be rendered using Graphviz-compatible tools to help inspect the compiled pattern structure.

Returns: A string containing the Graphviz DOT representation.

4460            raise ValueError("Backreference patterns cannot be converted to a DFA")
4461        if self._has_conditionals:
4462            raise ValueError("Conditional groups cannot be converted to a DFA")
4463        return DFA.from_regex(self, alphabet)

342class RegexLimits:
343    """Configure resource limits for regular expression processing.
344
345    These limits help control pattern complexity, automaton construction,
346    and execution costs.
347
348    All values must be positive integers. Boolean values are not accepted.
349
350    Default limits:
351
352        - ``pattern_length``: 65,536 characters maximum.
353        - ``group_depth``: 100 nested groups maximum.
354        - ``repeat``: 49,999 maximum counted-repeat bound.
355        - ``nfa_states``: 100,000 maximum NFA states and VM instructions.
356        - ``dfa_states``: 10,000 maximum DFA states.
357        - ``dfa_alphabet``: 256 maximum DFA alphabet characters.
358        - ``backtrack_steps``: 1,000,000 maximum backtracking VM steps.
359
360    Note:
361        ``backtrack_steps`` limits the bounded backtracking VM.
362        It does not limit NFA execution.
363    """
364
365    pattern_length: int = _MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH
366    group_depth: int = _MAX_GROUP_DEPTH
367    repeat: int = _MAX_REPEAT
368    nfa_states: int = _MAX_NFA_STATES
369    dfa_states: int = _MAX_DFA_STATES
370    dfa_alphabet: int = _MAX_DFA_ALPHABET
371    backtrack_steps: int = _MAX_BACKTRACK_STEPS
372
373    def __init__(
374        self,
375        pattern_length: int = _MAX_PATTERN_LENGTH,
376        group_depth: int = _MAX_GROUP_DEPTH,
377        repeat: int = _MAX_REPEAT,
378        nfa_states: int = _MAX_NFA_STATES,
379        dfa_states: int = _MAX_DFA_STATES,
380        dfa_alphabet: int = _MAX_DFA_ALPHABET,
381        backtrack_steps: int = _MAX_BACKTRACK_STEPS,
382    ) -> None:
383        """Initialize resource limits.
384
385        Args:
386            pattern_length: Maximum permitted pattern length.
387            group_depth: Maximum nested group depth.
388            repeat: Maximum counted-repeat bound.
389            nfa_states: Maximum NFA states and VM instructions.
390            dfa_states: Maximum DFA states.
391            dfa_alphabet: Maximum number of DFA alphabet characters.
392            backtrack_steps: Maximum backtracking VM execution steps.
393
394        Raises:
395            ValueError: If any limit is not a positive integer.
396        """
397        object.__setattr__(self, "pattern_length", pattern_length)
398        object.__setattr__(self, "group_depth", group_depth)
399        object.__setattr__(self, "repeat", repeat)
400        object.__setattr__(self, "nfa_states", nfa_states)
401        object.__setattr__(self, "dfa_states", dfa_states)
402        object.__setattr__(self, "dfa_alphabet", dfa_alphabet)
403        object.__setattr__(self, "backtrack_steps", backtrack_steps)
404        self.__post_init__()
405
406    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
407        """Validate that every configured limit is a positive integer.
408
409        Raises:
410            ValueError: If a limit is zero, negative, or not an integer.
411        """
412        for name, value in vars(self).items():
413            if type(value) is not int or value < 1:
414                raise ValueError(f"{name} limit must be a positive integer")

- ``dfa_alphabet``: 256 maximum DFA alphabet characters.
- ``backtrack_steps``: 1,000,000 maximum backtracking VM steps.

4832def compile(
4833    pattern: str | bytes | Regex,
4834    flags: int = 0,
4835    limits: RegexLimits | None = None,
4836) -> Regex:
4837    """Compile a regular expression into a reusable Regex object.
4838
4839    Compiled patterns can be reused for searching, matching,
4840    substitutions, and other regular expression operations.
4841    Repeated calls with the same pattern, flags, and limits
4842    reuse a bounded compilation cache.
4843
4844    Args:
4845        pattern: Regular expression string, bytes, or compiled Regex.
4846        flags: Optional compilation flags.
4847        limits: Optional resource limits.
4848
4849    Returns:
4850        A compiled Regex object.
4851
4852    Raises:
4853        TypeError: If the pattern, flags, or limits have invalid types.
4854        ValueError: If incompatible arguments or flags are supplied.
4855        RegexSyntaxError: If the pattern contains invalid syntax.
4856        RegexComplexityError: If a configured complexity limit is exceeded.
4857    """
4858    if isinstance(pattern, Regex):
4859        if flags:
4860            raise ValueError("cannot process flags argument with a compiled pattern")
4861        if limits is not None:
4862            raise ValueError("cannot process limits argument with a compiled pattern")
4863        return pattern
4864    if not isinstance(pattern, (str, bytes)):
4865        raise TypeError("pattern must be a string or bytes")
4866    if not isinstance(flags, int):
4867        raise TypeError("flags must be an integer")
4868    if limits is not None and not isinstance(limits, RegexLimits):
4869        raise TypeError("limits must be a RegexLimits instance")
4870    if flags & DEBUG:
4871        return Regex(pattern, flags, limits)
4872    with _compile_lock:
4873        return _compile_cached(pattern, flags, limits or RegexLimits())

Compiled patterns can be reused for searching, matching, substitutions, and other regular expression operations. Repeated calls with the same pattern, flags, and limits reuse a bounded compilation cache.

Args: pattern: Regular expression string, bytes, or compiled Regex. flags: Optional compilation flags. limits: Optional resource limits.

Returns: A compiled Regex object.

Raises: TypeError: If the pattern, flags, or limits have invalid types. ValueError: If incompatible arguments or flags are supplied. RegexSyntaxError: If the pattern contains invalid syntax. RegexComplexityError: If a configured complexity limit is exceeded.

5030def escape(pattern: str | bytes) -> str | bytes:
5031    """Escape regex metacharacters and verbose-mode whitespace or comments.
5032
5033    Preserve the input type: strings produce strings and bytes produce bytes.
5034    """
5035    if not isinstance(pattern, (str, bytes)):
5036        raise TypeError("pattern must be a string or bytes")
5037    if isinstance(pattern, bytes):
5038        escaped = bytearray()
5039        for value in pattern:
5040            if chr(value) in _ESCAPED_PATTERN_CHARACTERS:
5041                escaped.append(ord("\\"))
5042            escaped.append(value)
5043        return bytes(escaped)
5044    return "".join(
5045        "\\" + character
5046        if character in _ESCAPED_PATTERN_CHARACTERS
5047        else character
5048        for character in pattern
5049    )
